title: Baby Steps
summary: Game prologue in Vault 101: the birth of the Lone Wanderer, choosing your appearance, and allocating your initial S.P.E.C.I.A.L. stats at age 1.
startCondition: Starts automatically when starting a new game.
rewards: "You're SPECIAL!" book (S.P.E.C.I.A.L. stat allocation)
Transition to the "Growing Up Fast" quest
missableWarnings: You will have one final chance to change your name, sex, and S.P.E.C.I.A.L. stats right before leaving Vault 101 at the end of "Escape!".

steps.title: Birth and character creation
steps.description: James (Dad) delivers you alongside Dr. Li. Choose your character's sex, name, and appearance using the Gene Projector interface.

steps.title: Allocate S.P.E.C.I.A.L. stats
steps.description: Walk over to the "You're SPECIAL!" book on the floor of the playpen. Each stat starts at 5, and you can redistribute them with 5 extra points to spend (40 total).
steps.tip: Keep Intelligence at 7–9 if you want to maximize Skill Points on level-up, and avoid setting any stat to 10—there are Bobbleheads in the game (+1 to each S.P.E.C.I.A.L. stat).

steps.title: Leave the playpen
steps.description: Open the playpen latch, pick up a toy, or simply walk over to Dad near the exit to advance to the next stage of childhood.

objectives.text: Walk to Dad.
Open the playpen door.
Exit the playpen.
Look at the "You're SPECIAL!" book.
Jump up onto the chair to reach the toy chest.
Grab a toy and drag it into the playpen.
Play with your toys.
Follow Dad.

logs: Walk over to Dad in the delivery room.
Open the baby playpen gate.
Climb out of the playpen into the nursery.
Read the "You're SPECIAL!" children's book and allocate your primary attributes.
Pick up a toy and drag it onto the play mat.
Wait for Dad to return to the nursery.
Follow Dad toward the exit of the room.

title: Growing Up Fast
summary: Tenth birthday party in the Vault 101 cafeteria: first presents, meeting Amata and Butch, receiving your Pip-Boy 3000, and practicing with a BB Gun.
startCondition: Starts automatically after "Baby Steps".
rewards: Pip-Boy 3000
BB Gun
Security Baton
Sweetroll (or "Grognak the Barbarian" comic book)
missableWarnings: Be sure to talk to Old Lady Palmer for a Sweetroll, Stanley for a baseball cap (optional), and get the comic book from Amata.

steps.title: Get the Pip-Boy 3000 and mingle with the guests
steps.description: Overseer Alphonse Almodovar gives you your first Pip-Boy 3000. Talk to Amata (gives you "Grognak the Barbarian"), Mr. Stevenson, and Old Lady Palmer (give the Sweetroll to Butch or keep it).

branches.label: Stand up to or reason with Butch
branches.summary: Persuade Butch not to take the Sweetroll or call security.
branches.outcome: Positive reaction without a fight.

branches.label: Hand over the Sweetroll or fight
branches.summary: Win the fistfight or give up the Sweetroll.
branches.outcome: Butch backs off and the party continues.

steps.title: Head down to the reactor level
steps.description: Go down to the lower level to meet your father (James). Stop by to see Jonas on the way, then enter the reactor room.

steps.title: BB Gun and Radroach
steps.description: Pick up your birthday BB Gun, shoot the targets, and eliminate the Radroach that appears to wrap up your birthday.

objectives.text: Enjoy your birthday party and talk to the guests.
Meet Jonas on the reactor level.
Shoot all three targets with the BB Gun.
Kill the Radroach with the BB Gun.
Stand next to Dad and pose for Jonas's photo.

logs: Celebrate your tenth birthday and mingle with the guests in the cafeteria.
Dad finished his birthday speech and invited you down to the reactor level.
Follow Dad to the lower level for a surprise gift.
Hit all 3 targets using your new BB Gun.
Kill the Radroach with the BB Gun.
Stand next to Dad so Jonas can take a commemorative photo.

title: Future Imperfect
summary: Sixteenth birthday: taking the G.O.A.T. exam, choosing three Tag Skills, and dealing with the Tunnel Snakes.
startCondition: Starts automatically after "Growing Up Fast".
rewards: 3 Tag Skills (+15 to each)
missableWarnings: Regardless of your answers on the G.O.A.T., you can manually pick any 3 Tag Skills right after turning the test in to Mr. Brotch.

steps.title: Talk to Dad in the clinic
steps.description: Listen to James's advice and head to the classroom. In the hallway, Butch, Wally, and Paul are harassing Amata.

steps.title: Deal with the Tunnel Snakes
steps.description: Help Amata: convince Butch to leave peacefully, intimidate them, or get into a brief brawl.

steps.title: Take the G.O.A.T. exam
steps.description: Talk to Mr. Brotch and sit at a desk. Answer the 10 questions (or convince Mr. Brotch to skip the test) and confirm your three Tag Skills.
steps.tip: For an easy start, consider tagging Small Guns, Lockpick, and Science (or Speech/Repair).

objectives.text: Go to the classroom and talk to Mr. Brotch about the exam.
Take the G.O.A.T.
Turn your exam in to Mr. Brotch.
Leave the classroom.

title: Escape!
summary: Prologue climax: James has fled Vault 101, and the Overseer has sounded the alarm and killed Jonas. Fight your way to the main Vault door and step out into the Capital Wasteland.
startCondition: Starts automatically after "Future Imperfect".
rewards: 10mm Pistol
Medicine Bobblehead (in Dad's office!)
Tunnel Snakes Outfit
Access to the Capital Wasteland
Quest "Following in His Footsteps"
missableWarnings: BE SURE to grab the Medicine Bobblehead (+10 Medicine) from the desk in Dad's clinic before escaping—you can only return later during "Trouble on the Homefront"!
If you spare the Overseer (Amata's father), it will be easier to reach a peaceful resolution later in "Trouble on the Homefront".

steps.title: Gather gear in the living quarters
steps.description: Amata wakes you up and gives you a 10mm Pistol (you can also convince her to keep it for herself). Search your dresser for Stimpaks and a Baseball Bat.

steps.title: Save Butch's mother (optional)
steps.description: In the hallway, Butch asks you to save his mother from Radroaches. Help her to earn the Tunnel Snakes Outfit.

steps.title: The clinic and the Medicine Bobblehead
steps.description: Enter James's office. Pick up the Medicine Bobblehead from the desk, listen to the holotape on the terminal, and loot Jonas's body for a note and ammo.

steps.title: The Overseer's office and secret passage
steps.description: Reach the Overseer's office (you can interrogate/kill him or sneak in using the password/key from Amata). Hack the terminal (Science 50) or open the secret passage under the Overseer's desk.

branches.label: Spare the Overseer
branches.summary: Leave Alphonse Almodovar alive, knock him out, or slip past him.
branches.outcome: Amata is grateful; MS16 can be resolved peacefully.

branches.label: Kill the Overseer
branches.summary: Eliminate the Overseer in combat and take his key.
branches.outcome: Amata will resent you as you leave, and a new Overseer will replace her later.

steps.title: Open the Vault 101 door
steps.description: Head down to the massive gear-shaped Vault door, activate the control console, fend off the guards, and exit into the tunnel. Before stepping into the wasteland, you will get one last chance to rebuild your character.

objectives.text: Talk to Amata about her plan to escape the Vault.
Break into the Overseer's office.
Open the secret tunnel using the Overseer's computer.
Reach the reactor control room.
Restore power.
Open the Vault door.
Escape the Vault.

logs: Break into the Vault 101 Overseer's office.
Use the Overseer's terminal to open the secret escape tunnel.
Make your way to the reactor control room.
Restore electrical power.
Thrown the first breaker in the reactor room—Vault security sounds the alarm.
Activate the opening mechanism for the main Vault 101 door.
Leave Vault 101 and step out into the Capital Wasteland.

title: The Search Continues
summary: Overarching storyline quest for the first half of Fallout 3's main campaign: tracking down your missing father, James, through leads in Megaton, Galaxy News Radio, the Rivet City lab, and Smith Casey's Garage.
startCondition: Starts automatically upon exiting Vault 101 into the Capital Wasteland at the end of "Escape!".
rewards: Story transitions to "Following in His Footsteps", "Galaxy News Radio", and "Scientific Pursuits"
Discovery of key Capital Wasteland locations (Megaton, Rivet City, Vault 112)
missableWarnings: Heading straight to Rivet City or Smith Casey's Garage will skip or prematurely complete "Following in His Footsteps" and "Galaxy News Radio"—follow the trail in order so you don't miss out on XP and the key to Three Dog's weapons cache.

steps.title: Ask around about James in Megaton
steps.description: Head down from the Vault 101 scenic overlook through the ruins of Springvale to the gates of Megaton. Question Sheriff Lucas Simms and saloon owner Colin Moriarty about your father's recent visit.
steps.tip: You can read the records of James's trail for free by hacking Moriarty's terminal in the back room of his saloon.

steps.title: Follow the trail from Three Dog's studio to Rivet City
steps.description: Following Moriarty's lead, navigate the Metro tunnels to the Galaxy News Radio building and speak with DJ Three Dog, who will point you to Dr. Madison Li in the Rivet City Science Lab.

steps.title: Check the journals at Jefferson Memorial and find Vault 112
steps.description: In the Project Purity rotunda, listen to James's holotapes (especially Entry #10), which reveal that he went to see Dr. Stanislaus Braun in Vault 112 beneath Smith Casey's Garage.

objectives.text: Continue searching for Dad.

title: Following in His Footsteps
summary: First steps into the Capital Wasteland: searching for your father leads you to the nearby town of Megaton and Moriarty's Saloon.
startCondition: Assigned automatically upon exiting Vault 101.
rewards: Information on your father's destination (Galaxy News Radio)
Transition to the "Galaxy News Radio" quest
missableWarnings: Don't miss "The Power of the Atom" and the player house in Megaton—they are tied to Sheriff Lucas Simms and Mr. Burke.

steps.title: Reach Megaton
steps.description: After leaving Vault 101, head southeast to the scrap-metal town of Megaton. Speak with Sheriff Lucas Simms near the entrance.

steps.title: Get information from Colin Moriarty
steps.description: Enter Moriarty's Saloon on the upper level of town. Colin knows where James went, but demands 100 Caps (or 300) or wants you to collect a debt from Silver in Springvale.

branches.label: Hack Moriarty's terminal
branches.summary: Sneak into the back room and hack Colin's terminal (you can also pickpocket the password from him or Gob).
branches.outcome: Get the Galaxy News Radio lead for free.

branches.label: Collect from Silver or pay up
branches.summary: Visit Silver in Springvale (400 Caps with a Speech check) or pay Colin directly.
branches.outcome: Complete your deal with Moriarty officially.

steps.title: Alternative: Go straight to Rivet City
steps.description: Experienced players can head straight to Dr. Li in Rivet City and bypass the radio station (skips MQ02, though you miss out on Three Dog's reward).
steps.tip: For the full story experience and the relay dish repair quest, follow the trail to Three Dog.

objectives.text: Visit the nearby town of Megaton and ask around about Dad.
Talk to Colin Moriarty about Dad.
(Optional) Deal with Silver in Springvale.
Continue searching for Dad.
Find Galaxy News Radio.
Take the Fat Man from the fallen Brotherhood Soldier.
Help defeat the Super Mutant Behemoth.
Ask Three Dog about Dad.

title: Galaxy News Radio
summary: Journey through ruined Metro tunnels to the Galaxy News Radio building, battle a Super Mutant Behemoth alongside Lyons' Pride, and recover a communications dish for the relay.
startCondition: Obtain the lead from Moriarty (or Nova, or by listening to / learning about Three Dog).
rewards: 300 XP
Key to Hamilton's Hideaway cache (if you pass a Speech check)
Information about Rivet City
missableWarnings: During the battle outside GNR, make sure to pick up the Fat Man from the fallen Brotherhood of Steel Paladin—it's ideal for taking down the Behemoth.

steps.title: Navigate the Metro to Chevy Chase
steps.description: Enter Farragut West Metro Station, then pass through Tenleytown/Friendship to emerge in Chevy Chase. Watch out for Feral Ghouls and Raiders.

steps.title: Repel the attack at GNR Building Plaza
steps.description: Join Sentinel Lyons' squad (Brotherhood of Steel). After a wave of Super Mutants, a massive Behemoth bursts onto the plaza—use the Fat Man mini-nuke launcher from the fallen Paladin near the fountain.

steps.title: Speak with Three Dog
steps.description: Use the intercom to enter the building and head up to the studio. Three Dog asks you to replace the broken communications dish on the Washington Monument.
steps.tip: If you pass a Speech check, Three Dog tells you about Rivet City right away and gives you the key to a rich weapons cache, while still letting you do the dish quest as an optional task.

steps.title: Restore the signal (Museum of Technology → Washington Monument)
steps.description: Head to the Museum of Technology, retrieve the dish from the Virgo II lunar lander display in the planetarium, then take the elevator up the Washington Monument (requires the security terminal password or a Brotherhood pass) and install the dish.

objectives.text: Find the Museum of Technology.
Retrieve the communications dish from the lunar lander.
Find the Washington Monument.
Repair the damaged relay.
Talk to Three Dog about Dad.
Talk to Three Dog about the weapons cache.

logs: Find the Museum of Technology in the D.C. ruins.
Retrieve the communications dish from the Virgo II lunar lander display.
Reach the Washington Monument on the Mall.
Install the dish and repair the damaged radio relay atop the Monument.
Return to the Galaxy News Radio studio and speak with Three Dog.

title: Scientific Pursuits
summary: Meeting your father's colleague Dr. Madison Li in Rivet City, an expedition to the Jefferson Memorial, and discovering James's trail leading to Vault 112.
startCondition: Complete "Galaxy News Radio" (or visit Dr. Li directly).
rewards: 400 XP
Progress toward Vault 112
missableWarnings: At the Jefferson Memorial, don't forget to collect all 10 Project Purity holotapes—they offer rich lore and clues.

steps.title: Find Dr. Li in Rivet City
steps.description: Travel to the southeast corner of the map (the Rivet City aircraft carrier). Head into the Science Lab in the ship's bow and talk to Madison Li.

steps.title: Search the Jefferson Memorial
steps.description: Travel to the Jefferson Memorial (clear the rotunda of Super Mutants). Look for your father's recordings in the gift shop or on the lower level.

steps.title: Listen to the "Entry 10: Vault 112" holotape
steps.description: In the rotunda, play James's tenth recording on the desk in front of the Project Purity console: he went to Vault 112 beneath Smith Casey's Garage.

objectives.text: Make your way to Rivet City.
Talk to Dr. Li about Dad and Project Purity.
Find Dad in the Project Purity control room.
Listen to Dad's journal entries to figure out where he went.
Listen to Dad's journal entry #10.
Make your way to Vault 112.
Put on the Vault 112 Jumpsuit.
Enter an unoccupied Tranquility Lounger.

title: Tranquility Lane
summary: Dr. Braun's virtual reality simulation "Tranquility Lane": finding your father turned into a dog, and choosing between Betty's sadistic tasks or activating the "Chinese Invasion" failsafe.
startCondition: Reach Smith Casey's Garage, descend into Vault 112, and sit in a VR Tranquility Lounger.
rewards: 500 XP
Rescuing your father (James)
"Tranquility Lane" achievement/trophy
missableWarnings: The secret good-karma route via the "abandoned house" lets you complete the simulation WITHOUT losing Karma!
Completing Betty's tasks causes a sharp Karma drop, though it yields a unique sadistic outcome.

steps.title: Enter Vault 112 and sit in a lounger
steps.description: Pass through Smith Casey's Garage, put on the Vault 112 Jumpsuit given by the Robobrain overseer, and climb into an available Tranquility Lounger.

steps.title: Talk to Betty (Dr. Braun) or uncover the secret
steps.description: In a monochrome 1950s neighborhood, you take the form of a child. Betty asks you to torment the residents. To bypass her cruel games on the good path, talk to Old Lady Dithers—she will mention the abandoned house.

branches.label: Good path: "Chinese Invasion" failsafe terminal
branches.summary: Inside the abandoned house, activate the objects in the exact musical order: Radio → Pitcher → Gnome → Pitcher → Cinder Block → Gnome → Bottle.
branches.outcome: Reveals a hidden terminal: run the "Chinese Invasion" failsafe program (opens the exit door with no Karma loss!).

branches.label: Evil path: Complete Betty's tasks
branches.summary: Make Timmy cry, break up the Rockwells, kill Mabel Henderson, then put on the Pint-Sized Slasher outfit and kill everyone else.
branches.outcome: Major Karma loss, and Betty personally opens the exit for you and your father.

steps.title: Reunite with your father
steps.description: Step through the exit door that appears, talk to the freed James, and return to the Wasteland.

objectives.text: Find Dad.
Find Betty and talk to her.
Make Timmy Neusbaum cry.
Report back to Betty.
Break up the Rockwell marriage without killing anyone.
Report back to Betty.
(Optional) Find and activate the secret Tranquility Lane terminal.
Find a creative way to kill Mabel Henderson.
Report back to Betty.
Grab the mask and knife behind the abandoned house.
Kill all the residents of Tranquility Lane.
Report back to Betty.
Escape Tranquility Lane.
Talk to Dad.

title: The Waters of Life
summary: Returning to Rivet City, restarting the purifier at the Jefferson Memorial, a sudden Enclave assault, and James's tragic sacrifice. Evacuating the scientists to the Citadel.
startCondition: Starts immediately after freeing your father from Vault 112.
rewards: 600 XP
Access to the Brotherhood of Steel Citadel
Power Armor (unlocks Power Armor Training in the Citadel)
missableWarnings: During the escape through Taft Tunnel, keep Dr. Li alive and watch Garza's health—you can give him Stimpaks or persuade the group to move on.

steps.title: Talk to Dad and Dr. Li in Rivet City
steps.description: Return to the Rivet City Science Lab with your father. James convinces Dr. Li to restart Project Purity.

steps.title: Prepare the purifier at the Jefferson Memorial
steps.description: Meet the scientists at the Memorial. Help Dad repair the pump (install fuses in the basement), drain the intake pipes, and restart the mainframe in the flooded control room.

steps.title: Enclave invasion and James's death
steps.description: While working in the rotunda, an Enclave force led by Colonel Autumn lands by Vertibird. Your father floods the chamber with lethal radiation to deny them the purifier.

steps.title: Evacuation through Taft Tunnel
steps.description: Follow Dr. Li through the hidden passage from the Memorial basement into Taft Tunnel. Fight off Enclave soldiers and Feral Ghouls, then open the sealed hatch leading to the Citadel gates.

objectives.text: Go to the Rivet City Science Lab.
Join the scientists at Project Purity.
Clear any remaining Super Mutants out of Project Purity.
Tell Dad that Project Purity is clear.
Escort the scientists into Project Purity.
Turn on the flood control pump.
Get the fuses from Dad.
Replace the blown fuses.
Restart the mainframe.
Speak to Dad via the intercom.
Drain the intake pipes.
Return to the control room.
Escort Dr. Li to the evacuation point.
Escort Dr. Li through Taft Tunnel to the Citadel.
Resolve the situation with Garza.
Escort Dr. Li through Taft Tunnel to the Citadel.

logs: Escort Dr. Madison Li and the surviving scientists inside the Brotherhood of Steel Citadel.

title: Picking Up the Trail
summary: Searching the Citadel archives for information on the G.E.C.K. and finding a way into Vault 87 either through lethally irradiated ground or the children's town of Little Lamplight.
startCondition: Complete "The Waters of Life" at the Citadel.
rewards: 500 XP
Information about Vault 87
missableWarnings: Learn Power Armor Training from Paladin Gunny in the Citadel (available after speaking with Elder Lyons)!

steps.title: Meet with Elder Lyons and Scribe Rothchild
steps.description: Speak with Elder Lyons and Scribe Rothchild. Use the Vault-Tec terminal in the Citadel's A Ring to check the list of Vaults—the G.E.C.K. should be inside Vault 87.

steps.title: Reach Little Lamplight
steps.description: The main entrance to Vault 87 is bathed in lethal radiation (>3,000 rads/sec), so head west into the caverns of Little Lamplight.

steps.title: Negotiate with Mayor MacCready
steps.description: The kids of Little Lamplight will let you inside if you rescue their friends from Paradise Falls (starts "Rescue from Paradise") OR pass a Child at Heart perk check / high Speech check.

objectives.text: Escort Dr. Li into the Citadel.
Get permission from Scribe Rothchild to access the pre-War computer.
Use the Vault-Tec computer in the Citadel archives to locate a G.E.C.K.
Ask Scribe Rothchild about Vault 87.
Find the entrance to Vault 87 in the Lamplight Caverns.
Gain entrance to Little Lamplight.
Enter Vault 87.

title: Rescue from Paradise
summary: Infiltrating the slaver camp of Paradise Falls to rescue the kidnapped children from Little Lamplight.
startCondition: Speak with Mayor MacCready in Little Lamplight.
rewards: 500 XP
Access to Vault 87 via Murder Pass or the reactor room
missableWarnings: If you already opened the gate to Paradise Falls via "Strictly Business" or have high Charisma, you can buy the kids' freedom or sneak them out without a massive firefight.

steps.title: Get inside Paradise Falls
steps.description: At the gate, guard Grouse demands you complete "Strictly Business" or pay 500 Caps (you can also pass a Speech check or wipe out the slavers).

steps.title: Find and free Squirrel, Penny, and Sammy
steps.description: The children are held in the slave pen past the main gate. You can buy them from Grouse (1,200–2,000 Caps), pickpocket the key from Forty, or start a riot and clear out the camp.

branches.label: Ransom or stealth escape through the pipe
branches.summary: Buy the children's freedom or work with Sammy by repairing the junction box behind the pen (Repair).
branches.outcome: The children slip away quietly through the drainage pipe and the slavers remain non-hostile.

branches.label: Assault Paradise Falls
branches.summary: Free the captives by force, eliminating Grouse and the slaver guards.
branches.outcome: Lots of lootable weapons and positive Karma.

steps.title: Return to Little Lamplight
steps.description: MacCready will open the way into Vault 87 for you (normally via Murder Pass, or Joseph can hack the back door terminal with Science 50).

objectives.text: Gain entrance to Paradise Falls.
Find the kidnapped Little Lamplight kids and talk to them.
Hook the store computer into the Paradise Falls security network.
Tell Squirrel the computer is hooked into the network.
Get Forty away from the slave pens.
Tell Squirrel the guard is distracted.
Talk to Penny and convince her to leave Paradise Falls.
Find a way to get Rory Maclaren out of The Box.
Talk to Penny and convince her to leave Paradise Falls.
Meet the kids southwest of Paradise Falls.
Lead the kids out of Paradise Falls.
Reach the slave pen and talk to the kids.
Open the slave pen gate.
Tell the kids to run out of Paradise Falls.
Meet the kids southwest of Paradise Falls.

title: Finding the Garden of Eden
summary: Exploring the irradiated laboratories of Vault 87, meeting the intelligent Super Mutant Fawkes, retrieving the G.E.C.K., and being captured by the Enclave.
startCondition: Enter Vault 87 through Little Lamplight.
rewards: 600 XP
G.E.C.K. (temporarily)
Ability to recruit Fawkes as a companion later (with high Good Karma)
missableWarnings: Bring plenty of Rad-X, RadAway, and a Radiation Suit if you plan to retrieve the G.E.C.K. yourself without Fawkes's help.

steps.title: Fight your way to the test chambers
steps.description: Push through the sectors of Vault 87 swarming with Super Mutants and Centaurs until you reach the test labs.

steps.title: Free Fawkes (the Super Mutant)
steps.description: In one of the sealed chambers behind glass sits an intelligent Super Mutant named Fawkes. Use the security terminal (or the fire alarm switch nearby) to unlock his cell.

steps.title: Retrieve the G.E.C.K. from the irradiated chamber
steps.description: Ask Fawkes to fetch the G.E.C.K.—he is immune to radiation and can retrieve the briefcase safely (or go in yourself stocked up on RadAway).

steps.title: Colonel Autumn's ambush
steps.description: As you try to leave Vault 87, an Enclave squad knocks you out with a flashbang, seizes the G.E.C.K., and hauls you off to Raven Rock.

objectives.text: Find the underground entrance to Vault 87.
Retrieve the G.E.C.K.
(Optional) Release Fawkes from his chamber.
Escape Vault 87.

logs: Find the underground entrance to Vault 87 via the Little Lamplight caverns.
Locate and retrieve the Garden of Eden Creation Kit (G.E.C.K.).
Release the Super Mutant Fawkes from isolation (optional).
Escape the Vault 87 laboratories with the G.E.C.K.

title: The American Dream
summary: Interrogation by Colonel Autumn inside the Enclave base at Raven Rock, a face-to-face meeting with President John Henry Eden (a ZAX supercomputer), and escaping with the modified FEV.
startCondition: Starts automatically after being captured at the end of "Finding the Garden of Eden".
rewards: 700 XP
Modified FEV vial (optional)
Energy Weapons Bobblehead (DO NOT MISS IT!)
missableWarnings: BE SURE to grab the Energy Weapons Bobblehead from the desk in Colonel Autumn's quarters (Level 2, before leaving the base)—you CANNOT return to Raven Rock after this quest!

steps.title: Escape interrogation and recover your gear
steps.description: After Autumn's interrogation, President Eden unlocks your cell door. Grab your belongings from the locker near the exit and fight or sneak your way to the upper levels.

steps.title: Clear Level 2 and grab the Energy Weapons Bobblehead
steps.description: The level is crawling with Enclave soldiers (Eden turns off some of the bots, but the troops remain loyal to Autumn). Enter Colonel Autumn's office and take the Energy Weapons Bobblehead off his desk!

steps.title: Speak with President Eden
steps.description: Ride up to the control deck. Eden turns out to be an AI. He hands you a vial of modified FEV to poison the purifier against mutants and tells you to leave.

branches.label: Convince Eden to self-destruct
branches.summary: Use Science or Speech to expose the logical contradiction in Eden's directive.
branches.outcome: Eden initiates Raven Rock's self-destruct sequence and gives you the override.

branches.label: Take the FEV (or refuse)
branches.summary: Take the FEV vial (you can simply choose not to use it in the finale) and head down to the exit.
branches.outcome: Exit the base through the hangar.

steps.title: Exit to the surface and return to the Citadel
steps.description: Outside the exit, Fawkes waits armed with a Gatling Laser (if you freed him in Vault 87 and have Good Karma). Return to the Citadel.

objectives.text: Get out of the chair.
Retrieve your gear from the locker.
Meet with President Eden in his office.
Take the modified FEV vial.
Escape the Enclave base.
Report to Elder Lyons at the Citadel.

logs: If Fawkes was freed in Vault 87, he arrives outside the Raven Rock exit to assist the Lone Wanderer.

title: Take it Back!
summary: The final battle for the Capital Wasteland: the towering combat robot Liberty Prime's march to the Jefferson Memorial, a final showdown with Colonel Autumn, and activating Project Purity.
startCondition: Report to Elder Lyons at the Citadel after escaping Raven Rock.
rewards: Completion of the Fallout 3 main story (with the Broken Steel DLC, the game continues afterward!)
missableWarnings: If you have Broken Steel installed (included in GOTY!), sending Sarah Lyons, yourself, or a companion into the rotunda does NOT end the game permanently—the story resumes 2 weeks later!

steps.title: Briefing in the Citadel Lab and activating Liberty Prime
steps.description: After the briefing with Sarah Lyons and Scribe Rothchild, head down to the Citadel courtyard. The Scribes bring the giant robot Liberty Prime online.

steps.title: Prime's march across Memorial Bridge
steps.description: Follow Liberty Prime toward the Jefferson Memorial as he tears through force fields, Vertibirds, and Enclave troops. Help Lyons' Pride clear the flanks.

steps.title: Breach the rotunda and face Colonel Autumn
steps.description: Enter the Memorial with Sarah Lyons. Inside the rotunda, Colonel Autumn awaits with his guards. You can fight him or talk him into standing down (high Speech).

steps.title: Activate Project Purity
steps.description: Enter the code 2-1-6 (your mother's favorite Bible verse, Revelation 21:6) at the purifier console. Choose whether or not to insert Eden's FEV vial, then decide who enters the irradiated chamber.

branches.label: Enter yourself or send Fawkes / Charon / RL-3
branches.summary: With Broken Steel, radiation-immune companions (Fawkes, Charon, Sergeant RL-3) can enter in your place without fatal consequences.
branches.outcome: Project Purity comes online with clean water, and Broken Steel begins 2 weeks later!

branches.label: Insert the modified FEV
branches.summary: Load Eden's vial into the purifier receptacle before activation.
branches.outcome: Wasteland water kills all mutants and anyone carrying mutations (massive Karma loss).

objectives.text: Follow Elder Lyons to the Citadel Laboratory.
Get instructions from Sarah Lyons.
Prepare for battle, then report to Sarah Lyons.
Follow Liberty Prime to the Purifier.
Reach the Project Purity control room.
Secure the Project Purity control room.
Activate the Purifier!
Open the airlock.

title: Infiltration

rewards: Prototype power source to bring the giant robot Liberty Prime online
Access to the final briefing with Elder Owyn Lyons before "Take it Back!"

steps.title: Retrieve the experimental power source
steps.description: Stage 20 required navigating flooded corridors and traps inside the ship's hold to recover a pre-War prototype power unit.

steps.title: Deliver the prototype to Scribe Rothchild at the Citadel
steps.description: In Stage 30, the recovered power source had to be brought to Brotherhood of Steel lead technologist Scribe Rothchild in the Citadel Lab to finish Liberty Prime.

steps.title: Report to Elder Lyons in the war room
steps.description: In the final step (Stage 40), the player climbed to the briefing room of Elder Owyn Lyons and Sentinel Sarah Lyons, kicking off the march to the Jefferson Memorial.

Alternate ending slides and major consequences for drinking water in Broken Steel

steps.title: Discuss the vial with Elder Lyons at the Citadel

branches.label: Give the FEV virus to Elder Lyons

branches.outcome: The final choice remains in your hands at the rotunda console.

steps.title: Make your choice at the Project Purity filtration panel
steps.description: After defeating Colonel Augustus Autumn in the Jefferson Memorial rotunda, approach the reagent canister slot before entering the code "2-1-6".

title: The Power of the Atom
summary: The fate of Megaton: disarm the unexploded atomic bomb in the center of the crater for Sheriff Lucas Simms, or rig it with a fusion pulse charge for Tenpenny's agent Mr. Burke.
startCondition: Speak with Sheriff Lucas Simms at the Megaton gates or with Mr. Burke in the back corner of Moriarty's Saloon.
rewards: My Megaton House + Wadsworth the robot butler + 100–500 Caps (Good path)
Tenpenny Tower Suite + 500–1,000 Caps (Evil path)
Chinese Assault Rifle, Sheriff's Hat, and Sheriff's Duster (if Burke shoots Simms)
missableWarnings: Detonating Megaton permanently destroys the town and nearly all its residents (except Moira Brown, who becomes a Ghoul).
BE SURE to grab the Strength Bobblehead from the bedroom desk inside Lucas Simms's house before destroying Megaton!

steps.title: Hear out Sheriff Simms and Mr. Burke
steps.description: Upon entering Megaton, talk to Sheriff Lucas Simms about the bomb in the crater (a Speech check raises the reward from 100 to 500 Caps). Then visit Moriarty's Saloon, where Mr. Burke offers a fusion pulse charge and up to 1,000 Caps to blow up the town.

steps.title: Decide whether to turn Mr. Burke in to the Sheriff
steps.description: If you tell Lucas Simms about Burke's plot and accompany him to the saloon to make the arrest, Burke will draw a silenced pistol as soon as the Sheriff turns his back. Shoot Burke first to save Simms's life!
steps.tip: If Simms dies, his son Harden Simms takes over the disarming quest, and you can loot the Sheriff's unique duster, hat, house key, and Chinese Assault Rifle.

steps.title: Disarm the bomb or plant the fusion pulse charge
steps.description: Walk down into the irradiated puddle at the base of the bomb in central Megaton. Either disarming it or rigging the detonator requires an Explosives skill of at least 25.
steps.tip: If your Explosives skill is too low, take Mentats (+5 Perception and +10 Explosives)—you can get some from Leo Stahl or buy them from Moira.

branches.label: Disarm the atomic bomb (Good path)
branches.summary: Disarm the bomb's detonator and report back to Lucas (or Harden) Simms.
branches.outcome: +200 Good Karma, 100–500 Caps, and the key to your own Megaton House.

branches.label: Rig the charge and detonate the town (Evil path)
branches.summary: Attach Burke's fusion pulse charge, travel to the Tenpenny Tower balcony, and press the detonator.
branches.outcome: -1,000 Karma, 500–1,000 Caps, and the key to a luxury suite in Tenpenny Tower.

Bottlecap Mine schematics and training from Bittercup

steps.title: Free Red and Shorty on the lower level

steps.title: Teach the residents to defend themselves and repel the Super Mutant raid

title: Lincoln Artifacts
summary: A major scavenger hunt for ten authentic relics of the 16th US President, Abraham Lincoln, inside the Museum of History: each artifact found can be given to Hannibal Hamlin's freed slaves, sold to collector Abraham Washington, or handed over to slaver Leroy Walker to be destroyed.
startCondition: Begin searching the Museum of History offices on The Mall, or speak with Hannibal Hamlin (Temple of the Union), Leroy Walker (Lincoln Memorial), or Abraham Washington (Rivet City).
rewards: Unique Lincoln's Repeater (.44 Magnum, 50 base damage, zero spread — best kept for yourself!)
Up to 1,500+ caps and positive Karma for selling or donating the other 9 relics
Lincoln's Hat (+1 Intelligence, +5 Speech)
missableWarnings: Before selling the Lincoln Memorial Poster to anyone, be sure to show it to Caleb Smith at the Temple of the Union during Head of State, or restoring the statue will be delayed!

steps.title: Search the Museum of History Lower Halls and Offices
steps.description: Enter the Museum of History (past the entrance to the ghoul city of Underworld — turn left through the double doors into the halls overrun by feral ghouls). Hidden across two levels of exhibits and offices are 10 artifacts: Lincoln's Repeater, Lincoln's Diary, Action Abe Action Figure, Lincoln's Hat, Lincoln's Voice, Gettysburg Address, Emancipation Proclamation, John Wilkes Booth Wanted Poster, Civil War Draft Poster, and Lincoln Memorial Coin.
steps.tip: The unique Lincoln's Repeater sits inside a corner glass display case on the upper level of the museum offices — grab it first!

steps.title: Show the Poster to Caleb Smith for Head of State
steps.description: If you are doing the Head of State quest, first bring the Lincoln Memorial Poster you found to stonemason Caleb Smith at the Temple of the Union so the former slaves can reconstruct the statue's shattered head.

steps.title: Choose a Buyer for Each Artifact
steps.description: All three interested parties are willing to buy the relics individually, and Speech or Barter checks double the payout for each item.

branches.label: Give the relics to Hannibal Hamlin (Good path)
branches.summary: After the Temple of the Union community relocates to the Lincoln Memorial, sell or gift the artifacts to Hannibal.
branches.outcome: Large positive Karma gain, caps, and the restoration of a historic monument for freed people.

branches.label: Sell the collection to Abraham Washington (Neutral path)
branches.summary: Bring the items to the Rivet City museum and pass Barter checks.
branches.outcome: You earn the highest commercial payout, and the items are put on display inside the aircraft carrier's cases.

branches.label: Turn the artifacts over to slaver Leroy Walker (Evil path)
branches.summary: Hand your findings over to the slaver leader at the Lincoln Memorial for destruction.
branches.outcome: Quick caps, but a Karma loss and the destruction of historical heritage.

steps.description: Speak with Doctor Zimmer and question the Wasteland's doctors: Doctor Preston (Rivet City), Red (Big Town), Doc Hoff, and Victoria Watts in Rivet City (she will try to persuade you to lie to Zimmer).

steps.title: Find Surgeon Pinkerton
steps.description: Swim or make your way to the broken bow section of the Rivet City aircraft carrier (enter through the underwater Lockpick 100 door OR the alternate door on the side facing the bridge). Fight past mines and mirelurks to reach Pinkerton.

steps.title: Uncover the Truth and Choose an Ending
steps.description: Pinkerton reveals that the android is Rivet City's security chief, Harkness! Listen to the evidence on Pinkerton's terminal and speak with Harkness.

branches.label: Protect Harkness (Good path)
branches.summary: Tell Harkness you will not turn him in, or ask to handle Zimmer yourself.
branches.outcome: You receive the unique A3-21's Plasma Rifle.

branches.label: Turn him in to Zimmer (Evil path / Double reward)
branches.summary: Give Zimmer Harkness's memory reset code.
branches.outcome: Zimmer grants the Wired Reflexes perk (+10% V.A.T.S.). If you claim the rifle from Harkness first and eliminate Zimmer right after receiving the perk, you get BOTH rewards.

objectives.text: Investigate the runaway android.
Visit Rivet City to learn more about the android from the Commonwealth.
Investigate the case of Zimmer's missing android.
(Optional) Find out what Doctor Preston knows about the android.
Continue searching for the android, OR tell Zimmer he is dead.
Find out what Pinkerton in Rivet City knows about the android.
Report to Zimmer, OR warn Harkness about Zimmer.

logs: The quest completes after revealing the android's secret to either Harkness or Doctor Zimmer (both rewards can be claimed before the final resolution).

title: Tenpenny Tower
summary: A heated conflict over the luxury skyscraper Tenpenny Tower: sentient ghouls led by former policeman Roy Phillips demand the right to live in the tower, while owner Allistair Tenpenny and security chief Gustavo seek to wipe them out.
startCondition: Approach the front gate of Tenpenny Tower in the southwest of the map and listen to Roy Phillips' argument over the intercom, then speak with Chief Gustavo.
rewards: Unique Ghoul Mask (makes ALL feral ghouls in the game completely friendly — reward from Roy Phillips!)
500–700 caps from Chief Gustavo (for eliminating the ghouls at Warrington Station)
missableWarnings: IMPORTANT: Even in the 'peaceful' diplomatic ghoul settlement ending, Roy Phillips will still dump all the human residents (including Allistair Tenpenny and Herbert 'Daring' Dashwood) into the basement a few in-game days later! Before finishing the quest in favor of the ghouls, make sure to get the Dart Gun schematics from Lydia Montenegro and complete Herbert Dashwood's mini-quest!

steps.title: Hear Out Gustavo and Allistair Tenpenny's Terms
steps.description: Speak with security chief Gustavo at the Tenpenny Tower lobby desk (he offers 500–700 caps to clear out Roy's hideout), then take the elevator up to the penthouse to meet Allistair Tenpenny, who agrees to let ghouls move in only if five key snobbish tenants leave the tower or change their minds.

steps.title: Meet Roy Phillips at Warrington Station
steps.description: Head west to the Warrington Trainyard and Metro Station, where Roy Phillips, Michael Masters, and Bessie Lynn are hiding. Roy offers either to secretly unlock Tenpenny Tower's sealed basement door for a pack of feral ghouls, or to pursue legal residency.

steps.title: Convince or Evict the Five Objecting Residents (Diplomatic Path)
steps.description: If you choose the peaceful route, speak with Mrs. Lancaster, Mr. Ling, Miss Montenegro, Edgar Wellington II, and Millicent Wellington. You can persuade them with Speech checks, or find Edgar and Susan Lancaster's love letters in a safe/desk to spark a scandal and drive all five away.

steps.title: Choose the Final Outcome for Tenpenny Tower
steps.description: Complete the quest via one of three paths and claim your reward.

branches.label: Diplomatic ghoul settlement
branches.summary: Get Allistair Tenpenny's approval after the five tenants leave and report back to Roy Phillips.
branches.outcome: Roy awards the unique Ghoul Mask and +300 Karma (though a few days later he secretly slaughters the remaining humans).

branches.label: Let feral ghouls in through the generator room
branches.summary: Hack the terminal (Science 50) or unlock the door in the tower basement using Gustavo's key.
branches.outcome: You receive the Ghoul Mask and loot from all the tower's shops, but lose 600 Karma.

branches.label: Eliminate Roy Phillips and his group
branches.summary: Kill Roy, Michael, and Bessie at Warrington Station and report to Gustavo.
branches.outcome: You earn 500–700 caps and keep all Tenpenny Tower residents alive, but miss out on the Ghoul Mask.

objectives.text: Kill Roy Phillips and his supporters.
Kill Roy Phillips and his supporters, or help the ghouls get into Tenpenny Tower.
Report to Chief Gustavo.
Help the ghouls get into Tenpenny Tower.
Help the ghouls get into Tenpenny Tower, or kill Roy Phillips and his supporters.
Tell Roy Phillips that the ghouls can move in.

title: Strictly Business
summary: A Paradise Falls slaver contract: gatekeeper Grouse issues an experimental hypnotizing emitter, the Mesmetron, along with slave collars to capture four Capital Wasteland residents.
startCondition: Speak with gatekeeper Grouse at the Paradise Falls gate (north of Arefu) and agree to complete the trial contract to gain entry to the camp.
rewards: Unique hypnotic weapon Mesmetron and its ammunition
250 caps per delivered captive (1,000 caps total) + unrestricted access to Paradise Falls
missableWarnings: Enslaving Flak removes a weapons merchant from Rivet City, and enslaving Red before completing Big Trouble in Big Town makes defending the settlement harder.
Even a good character can accept this quest just to get the unique Mesmetron for free, then wipe out the slavers and free the children in Rescue from Paradise!

steps.title: Get the Mesmetron and Target List from Grouse
steps.description: At the Paradise Falls entrance, refuse to pay the bribe and take the Mesmetron and a slave collar from Grouse. The list names four targets: sniper Arkansas (Minefield), arms dealer Flak (Rivet City), aristocrat Susan Lancaster (Tenpenny Tower), and doctor Red (Big Town).

steps.title: Master the Hypnosis and Collaring Mechanics
steps.description: Approach your chosen target out of sight of guards, save your game, and shoot them in the head with the Mesmetron. While the victim is dazed in a trance (holding their head), immediately talk to them, choose the option to put on the slave collar, and order them to run to Paradise Falls.
steps.tip: The Mesmetron has a chance to trigger a frenzy or explode the target's head instead of mesmerizing them — always quicksave before firing!

steps.title: Capture Arkansas and the Other Targets on the List
steps.description: It is easiest to start with Arkansas on the rooftop of a ruined house in the center of Minefield (he starts hostile, so sneak up behind him). If desired, continue hunting Susan Lancaster, Flak, and Red, returning to Grouse for a fresh collar after each captive.

steps.title: Collect Payment and Gain Entry to Paradise Falls
steps.description: After delivering at least one target from the list, Grouse pays you 250 caps and grants permanent access to the Paradise Falls courtyard and Eulogy Jones. Capturing all four targets nets a total of 1,000 caps.

objectives.text: Enslave the sniper Arkansas from Minefield.
Enslave Susan Lancaster from Tenpenny Tower.
Enslave Red from Big Town.
Enslave Flak from Rivet City.

title: Blood Ties
summary: The settlement of Arefu is being terrorized by a gang called The Family, and Lucy West from Megaton asks you to deliver a letter to her relatives — Evan King and the West family.
startCondition: Speak with Lucy West at Moriarty's Saloon or in Megaton.
rewards: Schematics - Shishkebab
Hematophage perk (Blood Packs restore 20 HP)
Protection for Arefu and peace with Ian West
missableWarnings: Do not attack The Family's guards in Meresti Metro Station on sight if you want to negotiate peacefully and learn the Hematophage perk!

steps.title: Visit Arefu and Check the West House
steps.description: Climb onto the ruined overpass of Arefu. Speak with Evan King and inspect all three houses — Lucy's parents are dead, and her brother Ian is missing.

steps.title: Find The Family's Hideout in Meresti Metro Station
steps.description: Following King's lead (or checking the three suspected locations: Hamilton's Hideaway, Moonbeam Outdoor Cinema, Northwest Seneca Station), descend into Meresti Metro Station via the radioactive barrel tunnels near Seneca Station.

steps.title: Negotiate with Vance
steps.description: Show your pass or speak peacefully with the guards, talk to The Family's leader Vance, and obtain the password to Ian West's room.

branches.label: Protection pact (Peaceful path)
branches.summary: Convince Vance to accept Blood Pack deliveries in exchange for guarding Arefu, then deliver Lucy's letter to Ian.
branches.outcome: The Family protects Arefu, and you earn the Shishkebab schematics and Hematophage perk.

branches.label: Destroy The Family
branches.summary: Free Ian by force and wipe out the vampires.
branches.outcome: Ian returns to Arefu, but you will not receive the Hematophage perk.

objectives.text: Deliver Lucy's letter.
Find out what The Family has done to Arefu.
Check the West house.
Check the Schenzy house.
Check the Ewers house.
Return to Evan King.
Find The Family.
Find Ian West.
Speak with Vance about Ian's decision.
Return to Evan King.

logs: Deliver Lucy West's letter to her family in the overpass settlement of Arefu.
Search the West family house in Arefu and learn the fate of Lucy's parents.
Report to Evan King on the status of Arefu's residents.
Track down The Family's hideout in the underground tunnels north of Arefu.
Locate Ian West inside The Family's hideout at Meresti Metro Station.
Speak with Vance, leader of The Family, about Ian West's fate and the protection of Arefu.
Return to Evan King in Arefu and report the outcome of the negotiations.

title: Oasis
summary: Hidden at the far northern edge of the map lies the lush green grove of Oasis, where the Treeminders cult worships a living mutant tree named Harold (familiar from Fallout 1 and 2!).
startCondition: Travel to Oasis (far north-center of the Capital Wasteland) and undergo the purification ritual with Tree Father Birch.
rewards: Barkskin perk (+5% Damage Resistance)
Unique Poplar's Hood / Mask / Charm
Miss Launcher or Linden's Outcast Power Armor (depending on your choice!)
missableWarnings: The secret 'ideal' approach is to head down into the caves and apply either Birch's Sap (halting growth without killing him) or Laurel's Liniment (spreading the forest) to Harold's heart — do NOT burn him!

steps.title: Purification Ceremony with Tree Father Birch
steps.description: Upon entering Oasis, drink the sap from the basin and experience the vision. Shortly after, the gate to Harold himself will be opened for you.

steps.title: Listen to Harold's Request and the Keepers' Views
steps.description: Harold has grown weary of being rooted in place and asks you to end his life. However, Tree Father Birch wants to halt his growth, while Leaf Mother Laurel wants to accelerate the forest's spread across the Wasteland.

steps.title: Descend into the Damp Caves and Decide Harold's Fate
steps.description: Fight through the mirelurk-infested caves underground to reach Harold's heart.

branches.label: Apply Leaf Mother Laurel's Liniment (Spread the greenery)
branches.summary: Apply Laurel's Liniment to the heart and speak with Harold (a Speech check convinces him to live for the Wasteland's sake).
branches.outcome: Barkskin perk (+5% DR), Poplar's Hood, and Linden's Outcast Power Armor.

branches.label: Apply Tree Father Birch's Sap (Halt the growth)
branches.summary: Apply Birch's Sap to the heart.
branches.outcome: Barkskin perk, Miss Launcher / armor.

branches.label: Destroy the heart (or burn Harold)
branches.summary: Destroy the heart underground as Harold requested (or burn him alive above ground — the evil path with no rewards).
branches.outcome: Harold dies peacefully (if done via the heart), and you receive the Barkskin perk.

objectives.text: Take part in the Treeminders' ritual.
(Optional) Get the cave key from Branchtender Cypress.
Enter the underground caves and destroy Harold's heart.
(Optional) Apply Birch's sap to Harold's heart to stop his growth.
(Optional) Apply Laurel's liniment to Harold's heart to accelerate his growth.
(Optional) Burn Harold to death.
Speak with Tree Father Birch.
Speak with Leaf Mother Laurel.

title: Abraham Washington Buys Stuff
summary: Buying pre-war historical relics in Rivet City: Capitol Preservation Society curator Abraham Washington is willing to pay handsomely for the original Bill of Rights, the Magna Carta, and artifacts from Abraham Lincoln's era.
startCondition: Speak with Abraham Washington in his museum on Rivet City's mid deck (before, during, or after the Stealing Independence quest).
rewards: 75–100 caps for the Bill of Rights and 75–100 caps for the Magna Carta
40 to 200 caps for each Abraham Lincoln artifact sold (with high Barter/Speech)
Donated exhibits added to the Rivet City museum's glass display cases
missableWarnings: It is more rewarding and noble to give the Lincoln artifacts to Hannibal Hamlin and Caleb Smith at the Lincoln Memorial (Head of State / Lincoln Artifacts), and NEVER sell the unique Lincoln's Repeater (.44 Magnum) — it is one of the strongest rifles in the game!

steps.title: Ask Abraham Washington About Rare Documents
steps.description: Visit the Capitol Preservation Society museum on Rivet City's mid deck. Beyond the main contract for the Declaration of Independence, ask Abraham Washington about other historical relics he wants to buy for his exhibit.

steps.title: Find the Bill of Rights and Magna Carta in the National Archives
steps.description: During your expedition into the armored vault of the National Archives (Stealing Independence), thoroughly search the side safes in the eastern and western wings of the basement. Inside lie the surviving originals of the Bill of Rights and the Magna Carta.
steps.tip: Both documents can be picked up along the way before speaking with the Protectron Button Gwinnett in the main vault chamber.

steps.title: Sell the Documents with a Barter Check
steps.description: Return to Rivet City and offer Washington the parchments you found. Passing a Barter check raises the payout for each document from 75 to 100 caps, and the relics immediately appear behind the museum's display glass.

title: Trouble on the Homefront
summary: Returning home to Vault 101: some time after James's death, your Pip-Boy picks up an emergency radio broadcast from Amata, pleading for help to stop the Overseer's tyranny and civil strife.
startCondition: After completing the main quest The Waters of Life (MQ05), approach the area around Megaton or Vault 101, tune in to the Vault 101 Emergency Frequency, and open the entrance door with Amata's password.
rewards: Modified Utility Jumpsuit (+5 Repair, +5 Lockpick) or Vault 101 Security Armor
Final chance to grab the Medicine Bobblehead from James's office if missed in the prologue, plus schematics on the Overseer's terminal
missableWarnings: WARNING: After completing this quest and exiting into the cave, Vault 101's door seals FOREVER! Be sure to check your father's office (Medicine Bobblehead) and speak with Butch DeLoria so he heads to the Muddy Rudder in Rivet City as an available companion!

steps.title: Pick Up the Distress Signal and Enter Vault 101
steps.description: Once you catch the radio signal near Megaton, return to the Vault 101 cave and activate the door control pod with the new password. At the entrance, friendly Officer Gomez greets you and explains that the dwellers are split between supporters of the Overseer's strict isolation (Alphonse Almodovar or Allen Mack) and Amata's rebels pushing to open the Vault.

steps.title: Hear Out Amata, the Overseer, and Butch DeLoria
steps.description: Make your way to the clinic and living quarters to meet Amata and Butch. Amata asks you to convince the Overseer to step down without bloodshed, Butch suggests sabotaging the water purification system in the reactor room, and the Overseer in his office demands you crush the youth rebellion.

steps.title: Resolve the Political Crisis Inside the Vault
steps.description: Choose how to settle the conflict between the two factions of dwellers.

branches.label: Convince the Overseer to hand power over to Amata peacefully
branches.summary: Pass a Speech check with Alphonse Almodovar (or confront him with the Wasteland scouting logs from his terminal).
branches.outcome: Amata becomes the new Overseer, Vault 101 remains intact in peace, and gradually begins trading with the surface.

branches.label: Remove the Overseer by force or sabotage the water chip
branches.summary: Kill the Overseer (Amata will be horrified by her father's death) or follow Butch's advice to wreck the water purification system on the reactor level.
branches.outcome: Sabotaging the reactor forces all dwellers to evacuate into the dangerous Wasteland.

steps.title: Gather Keepsakes and Leave Vault 101 Forever
steps.description: Whichever path you take, Amata (or the Overseer) asks you to leave Vault 101 permanently to prevent further division. Collect any valuables, step out past the blast door, and receive your parting reward.

objectives.text: Return to Vault 101.
Find out what happened in Vault 101.
Put an end to the strife in Vault 101.
Stop the Overseer.
Stop the rebels.
(Optional) Sabotage Vault 101's life support systems.
(Optional) Leave Vault 101 forever.
Speak with Amata.
Speak with the Overseer.
Evacuate the Vault.
Leave Vault 101 forever.
All Vault 101 dwellers have perished.

logs: After completing The Waters of Life, Amata's emergency radio signal begins broadcasting near Megaton.
Obtained Amata's password — Vault 101's entrance door can now be opened.
Vault 101's door is open; Officer Gomez greets the Lone Wanderer at the entrance.
Vault 101 dwellers explained the standoff between the Overseer's isolationists and Amata's rebels.
The Lone Wanderer promised Amata to convince or remove the Overseer.
The Lone Wanderer agreed to help the Overseer crush Amata's rebellion.
The Lone Wanderer learned of a way to sabotage Vault 101's water chip to force the dwellers onto the surface.
The Lone Wanderer agreed to leave Vault 101 voluntarily, but can still change course before exiting the main door.
The Overseer has been neutralized or removed from power — report this to Amata.
The rebels have been stopped — report back to the Overseer of Vault 101.
The water purification system has been sabotaged: Vault 101 is preparing for emergency evacuation, and Amata meets you by the exit.
The crisis is resolved, though the Lone Wanderer must leave Vault 101 forever.
Both Vault 101 faction leaders (Amata and the Overseer) have died.
Vault 101's doors seal forever behind the Lone Wanderer.
The Lone Wanderer left Vault 101 voluntarily without intervening in the conflict, and the access codes were changed — quest failed.
The crisis in Vault 101 was resolved peacefully, yet for the community's safety the Lone Wanderer goes into exile.
With the water supply destroyed, the dwellers are forced to evacuate Vault 101 into the Capital Wasteland.

title: You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head
titleEn: You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head
summary: Mister Crowley in Underworld puts out a hit on 4 ghoul-haters (Dave, Dukov, Strayer, and Tenpenny) — but his true objective is their special keys to a secret cache at Fort Constantine!
startCondition: Speak with Mister Crowley at The Ninth Circle bar in Underworld (Museum of History).
rewards: T-51b Power Armor (the best base-game Power Armor!) at Fort Constantine
100+ caps per target
missableWarnings: Secret best ending: DO NOT give the keys to Crowley! Collect all 3 keys from the targets (via persuasion or pickpocketing — you do not have to kill everyone!), unlock the Fort Constantine bunker yourself, and keep the T-51b Power Armor!

steps.title: Accept Crowley's Contract
steps.description: Crowley asks you to assassinate Allistair Tenpenny, Dukov, Dave (Republic of Dave), and Ted Strayer (Rivet City) with a 'shot in the head' and bring back their special keys.

steps.title: Collect the Special Keys
steps.description: Question the targets about the keys: Tenpenny will give you a counter-offer (paying more to kill Crowley instead!), Dave's key is in his safe or pocket, and Dukov's and Strayer's keys can be obtained via Speech or pickpocketing.

steps.title: Fort Constantine — T-51b Power Armor
steps.description: Head northwest to Fort Constantine. Enter the CO Quarters (grab the key from Tara's body in the basement), descend into the Bomb Storage bunker, use the 3 special keys on the doors and stasis field, and claim the T-51b Power Armor!
steps.tip: If you turn the keys in to Crowley first, you can immediately pickpocket them back or eliminate him before he heads to the fort.

objectives.text: Kill Allistair Tenpenny.
Kill Dukov and take his key.
Find Dukov's key.
Kill Ted Strayer and take his key.
Find Ted Strayer's key.
Kill Dave and take his key.
Find Dave's key.
Tell Mister Crowley that Allistair Tenpenny is dead.
Bring Dukov's key to Mister Crowley.
Bring Ted Strayer's key to Mister Crowley.
Bring Dave's key to Mister Crowley.
(Optional) Kill Mister Crowley.
Collect your reward from Allistair Tenpenny.

title: Stealing Independence
summary: Rivet City museum curator Abraham Washington asks you to retrieve the original Declaration of Independence from the National Archives, racing ahead of mercenary Sydney.
startCondition: Speak with Abraham Washington at the Rivet City museum.
rewards: Unique Sydney's 10mm 'Ultra' SMG
Schematics - Railway Rifle
500 XP
missableWarnings: Try to keep Sydney alive! You can meet her later in Underworld, and if you bring her father's holotape ('A Note for Little Moonbeam') from the Statesman Hotel, she will give you her 'Ultra' SMG and remain a friend!

steps.title: Meet Sydney in the National Archives
steps.description: Enter the National Archives building near The Mall. In the Rotunda, Sydney is fending off a super mutant attack — help her out and team up.

steps.title: Button Gwinnett in the Vault
steps.description: Drop through the collapsed floor and safes to reach Button Gwinnett — a wig-wearing Protectron guarding the Declaration. Convince him with Speech (or bluff with the 'Forged' line), bring him ink from the Arlington Library plant, or destroy him.

steps.title: Elevator Exit and Reward
steps.description: Take the Declaration, ride the freight elevator straight back to the entrance with Sydney (speak with her to agree to split the reward), and return to Abraham Washington in Rivet City.

objectives.text: Retrieve the Declaration of Independence from the National Archives.
Defend the Rotunda.
(Optional) Bring ink to Button Gwinnett.
Return to Abraham Washington in Rivet City.

logs: Defend the National Archives Rotunda alongside Sydney against waves of super mutants.

title: Agatha's Song
summary: Elderly violinist Agatha asks you to find a legendary Stradivarius violin in Vault 92 so she can resume broadcasting classical music over the radio.
startCondition: Speak with Agatha at her secluded home (east of Rockopolis / west of Scrapyard).
rewards: Agatha's Station (a radio station playing violin music)
Unique Blackhawk revolver (if you bring sheet music paper from Vault 92 and ask for a reward!)
missableWarnings: In the men's dorm of Vault 92, don't forget to grab the Sheet Music Book — give it to Agatha after the violin to earn the unique Blackhawk revolver.

steps.title: Vault 92 — The Musical Experiment
steps.description: Travel northeast to Vault 92 (entrance through a cave/atrium with mirelurks). Check the terminals to learn that the Soil Stradivarius violin is stored in the sound testing lab.

steps.title: Find the Violin in the Sound Testing Lab
steps.description: Head down into the Living Quarters, then into the Sound Testing section. Hack the terminal or unlock the chamber holding the violin, and also collect the sheet music in the dorms.

steps.title: Return to Agatha
steps.description: Deliver the violin, listen to her first broadcast, and then hand over the sheet music (or pass a Speech check) to receive the Blackhawk.

objectives.text: Retrieve the Stradivarius violin from Vault 92.
(Optional) Find Vault-Tec Headquarters.
(Optional) Locate Vault 92.
Return to Agatha.
Find a buyer for the Stradivarius violin.

logs: Find the Stradivarius violin in the recording studios of Vault 92.
Return the Stradivarius violin to old Agatha at her house.

title: Reilly's Rangers
summary: A rescue operation for the elite mercenary squad Reilly's Rangers: three troopers are pinned down by super mutants on the roof of the Statesman Hotel, while their leader Reilly lies in a coma in Underworld.
startCondition: Tune in to the Rangers Emergency Frequency near downtown D.C. OR speak with Doctor Barrows at the Underworld clinic.
rewards: Ranger Battle Armor (best non-power armor in the base game: +1 Luck, +5 Small Guns, +10 AP) OR Eugene minigun
Wasteland Geo-Mapper (pays 30 caps for every newly discovered location!)
missableWarnings: Next to the Statesman Hotel inside Our Lady of Hope Hospital, grab the fission battery off a broken Protectron — you will need it to repair the elevator!

steps.title: Wake Reilly in Underworld
steps.description: In Underworld's Chop Shop clinic (Museum of History), pass a Medicine (50+) check on Reilly herself or ask Doctor Barrows to wake her so you can get the Rangers Compound password and ammo cache code.

steps.title: Our Lady of Hope Hospital -> Statesman Hotel
steps.description: The route to the hotel runs through super-mutant-infested Our Lady of Hope Hospital (head to the upper floors and cross the collapsed skybridge into the hotel). Grab the fission battery from the broken robot on the lower hospital floor!

steps.title: Repair the Elevator and Rescue the Squad
steps.description: Make your way to the roof of the Statesman Hotel, insert the fission battery into the broken elevator (or fix it with Repair), hand Butcher, Donovan, and Brick ammo from the crate, and fight your way back down to the street.

steps.title: Reilly's Rangers Compound
steps.description: Travel to the Rangers Compound east of Vernon Square. Reilly will reward you with either Ranger Battle Armor or the Eugene minigun, and offer paid Wasteland mapping work.

objectives.text: Find Reilly in Underworld, beneath the Museum of History.
Find Our Lady of Hope Hospital.
(Optional) Gear up at the Rangers Compound.
(Optional) Find the Reilly's Rangers ammo box.
Find Reilly's Rangers.
Find a fission battery.
Give the fission battery to Donovan.
Lead Reilly's Rangers to safety.
Reach the Statesman Hotel exit.
Return to Reilly at the Rangers Compound.

logs: Reach the Statesman Hotel via Vernon Square and Our Lady of Hope Hospital.
Climb to the roof of the Statesman Hotel to reach the besieged Reilly's Rangers squad.
Cover Reilly's Rangers' retreat down through the hotel floors and restaurant.
Lead the surviving Rangers out of the hotel to the street exit.
Return to the Reilly's Rangers Compound to claim your reward.

title: Lawbringer
summary: Bounty hunting on behalf of the Capital Wasteland's lawmen: upon taking the Lawbringer perk at Level 14, the Lone Wanderer joins the Regulators and turns in severed fingers from slain evildoers to Sonora Cruz.
startCondition: Select the Lawbringer perk upon reaching Level 14 or higher.
rewards: Unique Regulator Duster (+1 Charisma, +5 Small Guns)
10 caps and +5 good Karma per evil character's finger (plus 1,000 caps for the special bounty on J.D. Crockett!)
missableWarnings: Talon Company mercs, raiders, Paradise Falls slavers, and Enclave soldiers always drop a Finger upon death — an endless source of caps and positive Karma!

steps.title: Take the Lawbringer Perk and Find Regulator HQ
steps.description: Taking the Lawbringer perk adds the Regulator HQ marker to your map — a wooden farmhouse east of Jalbert Brothers Waste Disposal and north of the Corvega Factory. Head inside and speak with commander Sonora Cruz to receive the signature duster.

steps.title: Check the Special Bounty Warrants on Sonora's Desk
steps.description: Inspect the desk beside Sonora Cruz and read the bounties on high-priority Wasteland criminals (such as the elusive killer J.D. Crockett), who carry a hefty bonus reward.
steps.tip: A named criminal's unique finger brings up to 1,000 caps when turned in to Sonora Cruz.

steps.title: Collect Evildoers' Fingers for Caps and Karma
steps.description: While clearing raider camps, Talon Company ambushes, Enclave patrols, and slaver bases, loot trophy Fingers (0 weight) from the bodies and bring them to Sonora Cruz in exchange for caps and a boost toward Wasteland sainthood.

title: Contract Killer
summary: Secret assassination contracts for Littlehorn & Associates: upon taking the Contract Killer perk at Level 14, the hero collects ears from slain good-natured people and sells them to the mysterious Daniel Littlehorn at the Scrapyard.
startCondition: Select the Contract Killer perk upon reaching Level 14 or higher.
rewards: 10 caps and -10 Karma per good character's ear
Up to 1,000 caps for completing named contracts from the dossiers on Littlehorn's desk
missableWarnings: Turning in ears to Daniel Littlehorn rapidly lowers your Karma and triggers Regulator hit-squad ambushes when traveling across the map!

steps.title: Accept Littlehorn & Associates' Offer and Find the Scrapyard Office
steps.description: Right after selecting the Contract Killer perk, you receive a note with the coordinates of the Littlehorn & Associates office in a ruined building on the southern edge of the Scrapyard (south of Minefield). Go inside and meet Daniel Littlehorn.

steps.title: Review the Priority Target Dossiers on the Desk
steps.description: Read the contract notes on Littlehorn's desk listing notable defenders of order in the Capital Wasteland particularly hated by his employers, whose ears fetch a substantial bonus.

steps.title: Collect Good Characters' Ears and Claim Payment
steps.description: When killing Regulators, Brotherhood of Steel paladins, caravan guards, and peaceful settlers with positive Karma, loot trophy Ears from their corpses and deliver them to Daniel Littlehorn for caps.
steps.tip: If you maintain evil or neutral Karma for companions like Jericho, Clover, or Butch, turning in a few ears to Littlehorn is the fastest way to lower your Karma.

title: Aiding the Outcasts
summary: An expedition to a Brotherhood Outcasts outpost at Bailey's Crossroads: assisting Defender Morrill's squad against super mutants and entering a pre-war military simulation of the Liberation of Anchorage to unlock a sealed armory.
startCondition: Pick up the Outcast Distress Signal on your Pip-Boy and travel to Bailey's Crossroads Metro in the southern Wasteland.
rewards: Outcast Neural Interface Suit
Access to the underground bunker and the Operation: Anchorage simulation pod
missableWarnings: Once you enter the simulation pod, you cannot return to the Capital Wasteland or use your regular gear until the entire virtual campaign in Alaska is complete!

steps.title: Fight Through Super Mutant Positions at Bailey's Crossroads
steps.description: Exit Bailey's Crossroads Metro and help the Brotherhood Outcasts troopers clear the multi-level ruins and trenches of super mutant squads on the way to the bunker entrance.

steps.title: Descend to the Outcast Outpost and Speak with Protector McGraw
steps.description: Take the freight elevator at the end of the street down into the secret underground facility. In the command room, Protector McGraw explains that the armory containing pre-war T-51b armor is locked behind a simulation protocol that can only be operated by someone with an external Pip-Boy 3000 interface.

steps.title: Get the Neural Interface Suit from Specialist Olin and Enter the Pod
steps.description: Head into the tech bay to see Specialist Olin, receive the Neural Interface Suit, equip it, and step into the opened virtual reality pod to be transported to the snowy cliffs of Alaska.

objectives.text: Find the source of the Outcast radio signal.
Locate and enter the Outcast base.
Speak with the Outcast leader.
Investigate the VSS Outpost.
Follow Sibley to the simulator.
Put on the Neural Interface Suit.
Enter the simulator pod.

logs: Investigate the Brotherhood Outcasts radio signal near Bailey's Crossroads.
Help the Outcast troopers push through super mutant positions toward the outpost.
Speak with Protector McGraw inside the underground Outcast bunker.
Inspect the Virtual Strategic Solutions facility and obtain the Neural Interface Suit from Specialist Olin.
Enter the virtual reality pod and launch the Anchorage simulation.

title: The Guns of Anchorage
summary: First combat operation of the virtual campaign in Alaska: a stealthy cliff ascent alongside Sergeant Benjamin Montgomery, infiltrating a Chinese artillery bunker and destroying three long-range guns.
startCondition: Starts automatically right after launching the Anchorage virtual simulation pod.
rewards: Transition to General Chase's field headquarters and access to tactical requisition packages
4 of 10 Intel Briefcases (along the path to the artillery battery and inside the bunker)
missableWarnings: Warning: the Anchorage Cliffs area and the artillery bunker become PERMANENTLY inaccessible after destroying the three guns! Make sure to collect all 4 Intel Briefcases in this mission before planting the final charge!

steps.title: Traverse the Cliff Ledge and Meet Sergeant Montgomery
steps.description: Deploying on the snowy ledge with a Silenced 10mm Pistol and Trench Knife, neutralize the first Chinese sentries, use wall-mounted health and ammo dispensers, and link up with Sergeant Benjamin Montgomery by the suspension bridge.
steps.tip: The first Intel Briefcase lies in a room behind a locked door at the mid-level station before stepping onto the upper snowy bridge.

steps.title: Fight Through the Chinese Artillery Bunker
steps.description: Enter the rock-cut Chinese army complex alongside Montgomery. Clear the corridors, storage rooms, and barracks (watch out for flamethrower troops and snipers), refilling ammo at red ammo dispensers and collecting 3 more Intel Briefcases.

steps.title: Plant Charges on All Three Coastal Guns
steps.description: Emerge onto the upper artillery deck, eliminate the guards around the three massive cannons, and place explosive charges on the breech of each gun in turn. Stand back at a safe distance: once the battery blows, you are automatically transported to General Chase's command tent.

objectives.text: Infiltrate the Chinese artillery outpost.
Meet up with Sergeant Montgomery.
Destroy the three artillery guns.
Report to General Chase at the U.S. Army field headquarters.

logs: The Chinese artillery guns on the cliffs have been destroyed — Operation 'The Guns of Anchorage' is complete.

title: Paving the Way
summary: The sabotage phase of the liberation of Alaska from the U.S. Army field camp: selecting a weapon loadout, assembling your strike team with Lieutenant Morgan, and clearing the Listening Post and the Chimera Tank fuel depot.
startCondition: Begins in General Constantine Chase's command tent immediately after destroying the coastal artillery guns.
rewards: Opportunity to obtain the Gauss Rifle from the Quartermaster via a successful Speech check
4 Intel suitcases (2 at the Listening Post and 2 at the Chimera Depot)
missableWarnings: Be sure to ask the Quartermaster in the supply tent for the prototype Gauss Rifle (Speech check) and collect all 4 Intel suitcases inside the Listening Post and Chimera Depot before completing both objectives!

steps.title: Choose a weapon package and assemble your strike team
steps.description: Listen to General Chase's briefing, take the requisition markers, and speak to Lieutenant Morgan to recruit your strike team (infantry, heavy weapons, sniper, Sentry Bot, or Mister Gutsy). Then visit the Quartermaster, choose your combat loadout, and persuade him to issue the experimental Gauss Rifle.

steps.title: Clear the Chinese Listening Post in the ice mines
steps.description: Take the eastern trail through the ruined town and mountain mine shaft to the Listening Post. Inside, elite Chinese Crimson Dragoons in optical stealth armor appear for the first time. Eliminate the guards, collect 2 Intel suitcases, and download the data from the main communications terminal.

steps.title: Destroy the fuel tanks at the Chimera Tank Depot
steps.description: Return to camp (reinforce your strike team with Morgan if needed) and head through the western canyon toward the armor depot. Fight past the Chimera artillery tanks, find 2 more Intel suitcases inside the tents, and plant explosive charges on both massive fuel tanks.

steps.title: Report to General Chase that you are ready for the main assault
steps.description: After blowing up both fuel tanks at the Chimera Depot and clearing the Listening Post, return to the U.S. command tent and take command of the final assault on the pulse field facility.

objectives.text: Listen to General Chase's instructions.
Speak with Lieutenant Morgan.
(Optional) Speak to Sergeant Montgomery and have him lead your strike team.
Destroy the two fuel tanks at the Chimera Depot.
Capture the Chinese Listening Post.

logs: The Listening Post and the Chimera Tank fuel depot have been cleared — the way is open for the main assault.

title: Operation: Anchorage!
summary: The finale of the simulation — storming the pulse field compound and dueling General Jingwei. Returning to reality and surviving the mutiny among the Outcasts.
startCondition: Return to General Chase after completing "Paving the Way".
rewards: Winterized T-51b Power Armor (virtually never degrades!)
Chinese Stealth Armor
Gauss Rifle
Jingwei's Shocksword
Power Armor Training
missableWarnings: Immediately after opening the armory at Outcast Outpost in the real world, Sibley will mutiny against McGraw — try to protect Olin, as she can repair rare equipment!

steps.title: Disable the pulse field and breach the compound
steps.description: Assault the trenches alongside your strike team and tank robots. Fight your way to the pulse field generator and shut it down.

steps.title: Duel General Jingwei
steps.description: Breach the oil refinery compound. You can fight General Jingwei in combat or persuade him to commit seppuku with a Speech check!

steps.title: The Outcast Armory and Sibley's mutiny
steps.description: Return to the real world, unlock the armory using the newly accessible terminal, and defeat the mutinous Outcasts led by Defender Sibley. Claim your unique rewards.

objectives.text: Deactivate the pulse field.
