Enter the VSS Armory and take whatever you need.

title: Operation: Anchorage Simulation Intel
summary: Collecting all 10 secret Intel suitcases across the four stages of the Operation: Anchorage simulation to earn the permanent Covert Ops perk, along with field conversations with the War Correspondent and Dr. Adami.
startCondition: Activates automatically upon picking up any Intel suitcase or speaking with U.S. base personnel inside the Operation: Anchorage simulation.
rewards: Unique "Covert Ops" perk (+3 Science, +3 Lockpick, +3 Sneak permanently!)
Free healing from field medic Dr. Adami and wartime reports from the War Correspondent
missableWarnings: All 10 Intel suitcases can ONLY be collected while playing through the simulation — if you miss even one in "The Guns of Anchorage" or at the Listening Post, it will be impossible to earn the Covert Ops perk!

steps.title: Collect 4 Intel suitcases in "The Guns of Anchorage"
steps.description: On the cliffside climb, find the 1st suitcase inside the locked closet of the pumping station before the bridge to Montgomery. Inside the artillery bunker, grab the 2nd suitcase from a table in the bunkhouse barracks, the 3rd on top of crates in the room with the collapsed ceiling, and the 4th in the officer's corner office before exiting toward the three artillery guns.

steps.title: Speak with Dr. Adami and the War Correspondent at the U.S. camp
steps.description: At the U.S. forward base camp, visit the medical tent to see Dr. Adami (she instantly heals all wounds and crippled limbs) and give an interview to the War Correspondent near the entrance, who takes a propaganda photograph (the inspiration for the Anchorage Reclamation Memorial!).

steps.title: Collect 4 Intel suitcases in "Paving the Way"
steps.description: On the way to the Listening Post, pick up the 5th suitcase on the upper walkway of the ice mine and the 6th on a table in the main room of the Listening Post itself. On the route to the Chimera Depot, grab the 7th suitcase inside the abandoned shack near the crane and the 8th inside a corner tent within the tank depot.

steps.title: Find the final 2 suitcases in "Operation: Anchorage!" and earn the perk
steps.description: During the final assault in "Operation: Anchorage!", collect the 9th suitcase inside the dugout holding American prisoners along the left flank of the trenches, and the 10th inside the transformer booth directly behind the pulse field control console. Picking up the tenth suitcase immediately grants the permanent "Covert Ops" perk!

logs: Collected an Intel suitcase inside the Operation: Anchorage simulation (collecting all 10 grants the Covert Ops perk).
Field medic Dr. Adami is providing medical treatment at the U.S. Army forward camp.

title: Into The Pitt
summary: Journeying north to the radio tower of escaped Pitt resident Wernher: acquiring a slave outfit for disguise, riding a handcar through the train tunnel, and passing the confiscation checkpoint on the bridge into The Pitt.
startCondition: Listen to Wernher's Distress Signal on your Pip-Boy and meet him at the radio tower in the far north of the Capital Wasteland.
rewards: Access to the industrial ruins of The Pitt (formerly Pittsburgh)
Opportunity to obtain a slave outfit peacefully and free the slaves at the trainyard
missableWarnings: At the checkpoint across the bridge into The Pitt, the raiders temporarily confiscate all of your gear (it is returned completely intact after winning in The Hole arena in the next quest).

steps.title: Help Wernher fend off the raider attack at the radio tower
steps.description: Travel to the northern radio tower (northeast of Fort Constantine), eliminate the squad of Pitt raiders, and speak with Wernher. He asks you to infiltrate the infected industrial city of The Pitt disguised as a slave to steal a cure for the Trog mutagenic affliction.

steps.title: Acquire a slave outfit at the Ghost Train
steps.description: Head northwest to the slaver camp outside the train tunnel entrance. Eliminate the guards and take an outfit from a slain slave's body (or persuade the captive Ramsey to hand over a set of slave rags), and unlock the cages to free the surviving slaves.

steps.title: Cross the bridge into The Pitt and pass Mex's inspection
steps.description: Use the handcar inside the tunnel to travel to The Pitt. Put on the slave outfit, cross the mined suspension bridge, surrender your gear to gatekeeper Mex at the checkpoint (you can conceal the pistol Wernher gave you with a Sneak check), and enter Downtown.

objectives.text: Investigate the source of the radio signal.
Acquire a Slave Outfit.
(Optional) Acquire a Slave Outfit.
Return to Wernher.
Travel to The Pitt.
Gain entrance to The Pitt.

title: Unsafe Working Conditions
summary: Trials of a slave in The Pitt's Downtown: meeting Wernher's contact Midea, hunting for Steel Ingots among feral Trogs in the Steelyard, and fighting three lethal bouts in the irradiated arena known as The Hole to earn your freedom and reclaim your gear.
startCondition: Begins automatically after entering The Pitt's Downtown and witnessing the confrontation with the slave drivers.
rewards: Full return of all your confiscated gear from the footlocker near The Hole
Unique gear from blacksmith Everett for collecting Steel Ingots (up to The Perforator at 90 ingots and Tribal Power Armor at 100 ingots!)
"Pit Fighter" perk (+3% Damage Resistance and Radiation Resistance) and access to Uptown to meet Lord Ashur
missableWarnings: There are exactly 100 Steel Ingots hidden throughout the Steelyard and the abandoned steel mill! Collecting all 100 and turning them in to Everett unlocks every unique reward in The Pitt!

steps.title: Find Midea in the Downtown quarters
steps.description: Step in to defend the slave being beaten near the Downtown entrance and follow Midea back to her quarters. Wernher secretly visits you there and explains that the only way into fortified Uptown to reach Lord Ashur is to stand out during steel collection and win in the gladiatorial arena.

steps.title: Enter the Steelyard and gather Steel Ingots
steps.description: Pass through the gate to blacksmith Everett, grab the two-handed Auto Axe (or Wild Bill's revolver) from Marco, and venture into the Trog-infested Steelyard. Only 10 Steel Ingots are required for the main quest, but for every 10 additional ingots (up to 100 total), Everett rewards you with rare armor and unique weapons.
steps.tip: The Auto Axe shreds Trogs in seconds in V.A.T.S. or close combat and requires no scarce ammunition.

steps.title: Sign up for arena combat with Faydra and win 3 rounds in The Hole
steps.description: After returning to Downtown and hearing Ashur's loudspeaker speech, speak with arena coordinator Faydra. Pick your weapons from sponsor Krenshaw and win three rounds amid radioactive waste barrels: against three slaves, against the Bear Brothers, and finally against arena champion Gruber in Power Armor.

steps.title: Reclaim your gear from Krenshaw and head to Uptown
steps.description: Defeating Gruber earns you status as a free citizen of The Pitt and the "Pit Fighter" perk. Open the footlocker beside Krenshaw to retrieve all the gear confiscated on the bridge, then head through the Uptown gate toward Haven.

title: Free Labor
summary: The dramatic finale of The Pitt: an audience with former Brotherhood of Steel Paladin Ishmael Ashur in Haven, discovering that the "cure" is his newborn daughter Marie, and a wrenching moral choice between Ashur's harsh order and Wernher's bloody uprising.
startCondition: Begins immediately after winning the third match in The Hole arena and reclaiming your equipment.
rewards: "Booster Shot" perk (+10% Radiation Resistance) and access to the Ammo Press
Ashur's Power Armor (if you overthrow Ashur) or steady ammunition deliveries and toys for Marie (if you side with Ashur)
missableWarnings: There is no purely "good" side in The Pitt's conflict: Ashur and his scientist wife Sandra are genuinely close to synthesizing a vaccine in a clean laboratory, whereas Wernher is driven by personal vengeance and ambition.

steps.title: Ascend to Haven for an audience with Lord Ashur
steps.description: Cross the upper catwalks of Uptown into Haven and take the elevator to Ishmael Ashur's throne room. The former Lyons' Brotherhood soldier explains how he cleared the city of savagery and why he relies on forced labor until his wife Sandra finishes developing the vaccine.

steps.title: Enter Sandra's laboratory and learn the truth about baby Marie
steps.description: When a riot breaks out in Downtown mid-conversation and Ashur leaves the room, head into the research lab to meet his wife Sandra. You discover that the "cure" Wernher is hunting for is actually their infant daughter Marie, born with natural immunity to Trog degeneration.

steps.title: Make your choice at Marie's crib and track down Wernher's hideout
steps.description: Decide whether to abduct baby Marie from her crib (turning all Pitt raiders and the Ashurs hostile) or leave the child in Haven (causing the armed slaves to turn on you). Either way, make your way to Midea and then to Wernher's secret headquarters in the Steelyard.

branches.label: Side with Ashur and leave the child with her family
branches.summary: Leave Marie with her parents (or return her to the crib after confronting Wernher) and put down Wernher's rebellion.
branches.outcome: You eliminate or banish Wernher (via Speech check or the Black Widow perk); Sandra continues safe vaccine research and rewards you with a perk and access to the Ammo Press.

branches.label: Support the slave uprising and hand Marie over to Wernher
branches.summary: Bring the baby to Wernher, shut off the floodlights in the Steelyard to let a horde of Trogs into Uptown, and confront Ishmael Ashur.
branches.outcome: The Pitt raiders are defeated, you claim Ashur's unique Power Armor, and Wernher and Midea take control of the city.

title: Find Wild Bill
summary: A side investigation in The Pitt: searching for a slave named Wild Bill who went missing in the abandoned mill of the Steelyard and recovering his unique silenced .32 caliber revolver.
startCondition: Ask Midea in Downtown about the missing Wild Bill, or find his body on your own in the Steelyard.
rewards: Unique revolver "Wild Bill's Sidearm" (.32 caliber, high critical damage)
Bonus Steel Ingots located near Wild Bill's resting place
missableWarnings: Be sure to search the area around Wild Bill's body — more than a dozen Steel Ingots for Everett's collection are stashed right beside him and along the upper catwalks behind the mill!

steps.title: Ask Midea about Wild Bill's fate
steps.description: After your first conversation with Midea in the Downtown quarters, ask her about her missing friend Wild Bill, who ventured into the Steelyard to collect Steel Ingots and never came back.

steps.title: Find Wild Bill's body by the staircase of the abandoned mill
steps.description: Head into the Steelyard, pass through the large ruined mill hangar into an interior dead-end yard filled with rusted pipes, and climb the metal staircase on the left. At the base of the landing among slain Trogs lies Wild Bill's body — collect his farewell note and unique revolver, Wild Bill's Sidearm.

steps.title: Inform Midea of Wild Bill's death
steps.description: Return to The Pitt's Downtown and break the sad news to Midea that Wild Bill fell fighting Trogs to complete the errand and earn XP.

title: Death From Above
summary: Waking up in the Citadel two weeks after activating Project Purity: the Brotherhood is distributing water, while the Enclave has regrouped at a new base. Escort Liberty Prime to the Rockland Satellite Relay.
startCondition: Begins automatically after the ending of "Take It Back!" (MQ11) with Broken Steel installed.
rewards: Level cap raised to 30
Advancement toward Adams Air Force Base
missableWarnings: At the end of the mission, Liberty Prime is destroyed by an orbital strike — be ready to loot Enclave heavy weapons (Heavy Incinerator, Tesla Cannon) from nearby enemies.

steps.title: Briefing with Elder Lyons and Scribe Rothchild
steps.description: Wake up in the Citadel infirmary. Speak with Lyons and Rothchild — you must dislodge the Enclave forces from the Rockland Satellite Relay.

steps.title: Assault on the Rockland Satellite Relay
steps.description: Head northwest to the Rockland Satellite Relay, rendezvous with Liberty Prime, and push through the Enclave fortifications and force fields.

steps.title: Orbital strike
steps.description: Outside the satellite bunker entrance, the Enclave calls in an orbital strike from the Bradley-Hercules satellite, destroying Liberty Prime. Descend into the bunker, eliminate the guards, and retrieve the data module from the main terminal.

summary: Hacking the Enclave's orbital targeting system: descending into Olney Powerworks beneath Old Olney, overrun by deadly Deathclaws, to recover a Tesla Coil.
startCondition: Report to Scribe Rothchild after "Death From Above".
rewards: Tesla Cannon (upon completing component assembly at the Citadel)
Access to the Presidential Metro
missableWarnings: Old Olney is crawling with Deathclaws — be sure to bring the Dart Gun (instantly cripples their legs!) and plenty of heavy weapon ammunition.

steps.title: Speak with Scribe Vallincourt or Rothchild
steps.description: At the Citadel laboratory, you learn a Tesla Coil is needed to intercept the Enclave's orbital systems.

steps.title: Olney Powerworks in Old Olney
steps.description: Travel north to Old Olney. Enter the sewer manhole in the center of town and descend into the underground power plant. Find 3 switches or hack the terminals to disable the security force field.

steps.title: Retrieve the Tesla Coil and return to the Citadel
steps.description: Pull the Tesla Coil from the main reactor (which triggers security robots and electrical surges) and bring it back to the Citadel.

title: Who Dares Wins
summary: The decisive strike against Adams Air Force Base: navigating the secret Presidential Metro beneath the White House, storming the Enclave's massive Mobile Base Crawler, and choosing the target of the orbital strike.
startCondition: Begins immediately after delivering the Tesla Coil to the Citadel.
rewards: Heavy Incinerator / Enclave Hellfire Armor
Huge stockpiles of rare energy weapons
Deciding the fate of the Citadel and Adams Air Force Base

steps.title: Presidential Metro beneath the White House
steps.description: Enter the station near the White House (Rothchild provides the access pass). Fight past feral ghouls and security bots, deal with the M.A.R.Go.T. AI (via reprogramming or voice bluff), repair the train with a fuse, and travel to Adams Air Force Base.

steps.title: Storming the Enclave Mobile Base Crawler
steps.description: Across the sprawling airfield of Adams Air Force Base, fight your way to the Mobile Base Crawler while disabling turrets and taking down Enclave Hellfire Troopers (air support or the Tesla Cannon helps immensely).

steps.title: Satellite control center and finale
steps.description: On the crawler's bridge, reprogram the orbital satellite uplink. Then exit to the air traffic control tower and launch the orbital strike.

title: Protecting the Water Way

rewards: 200–400 caps from Scribe Bigsley for securing the trade route
Or a weekly cut of caps from One-Eyed Jack's gang and/or 500 caps extorted from Officer Lepelletier

steps.title: Speak with Scribe Bigsley and Officer Lepelletier in Rivet City
steps.description: Hear Scribe Bigsley's complaints at the Jefferson Memorial about missing Aqua Pura shipments, then head to the Rivet City bridge to speak with security officer Lepelletier. She directs you to patrol Officers Davis and Lorin along the northern bank of the Potomac.

steps.title: Track the raiders to Wilhelm's Wharf
steps.description: Reach the ambush site by the river north of Project Purity, inspect the wrecked caravan, and follow the trail up to the bandits' camp near Wilhelm's Wharf, led by One-Eyed Jack.

steps.title: Deal with One-Eyed Jack and report back to Rivet City
steps.description: Confront One-Eyed Jack and decide how to handle the gang: talk them into leaving with a Speech check, challenge Jack to a one-on-one duel (using knives, lead pipes, or nail boards), wipe out the entire gang, or strike a criminal deal with them, then report back to Lepelletier and Bigsley.

title: The Amazing Aqua Cura!
summary: Exposing the ghoul Griffon's scam outside the Museum of History: uncovering how the hustler turns the Brotherhood's pure water into the radioactive counterfeit "Aqua Cura" that supposedly restores ghouls' hair and smooth skin.
startCondition: Buy a bottle of Aqua Cura from barker Griffon in the Museum of History lobby (outside Underworld), or speak with his water supplier after Broken Steel starts.
rewards: Cap reward and good Karma for shutting down the scam and restoring clean water shipments to Underworld
Or a regular share of Aqua Cura profits (150+ caps) and free bottles by blackmailing Griffon
missableWarnings: Inside the Museum Authority metro station, Griffon's bottling plant is guarded by armed mercenaries and turrets — bring plenty of ammo or hack the security terminal!

steps.title: Check out Griffon's stall in Underworld and question Scribe Bigsley
steps.description: Listen to Griffon's sales pitch outside Underworld, question him about the source of his miraculous Aqua Cura, and then visit Scribe Bigsley at the Jefferson Memorial to find out who has been buying up the ghouls' clean water quota.

steps.title: Investigate the illegal bottling plant in Museum Authority
steps.description: Descend into the Museum Authority metro station on the Mall. Fight past Griffon's guards to the bottling line and pull the accounting records from the terminal proving that Griffon is watering down stolen Aqua Pura with dirty, irradiated water.

steps.title: Confront Griffon with the evidence and decide his fate
steps.description: Return to the Museum of History and expose Griffon's lie.

branches.label: Force Griffon to distribute clean water for free
branches.summary: Threaten to expose him to the residents of Underworld and demand he stop selling the counterfeit brew.
branches.outcome: The residents of Underworld receive genuine Aqua Pura, and you earn good Karma.

branches.label: Blackmail Griffon and cut yourself into the profits
branches.summary: Demand a percentage of the profits in exchange for keeping quiet about the underground plant in the metro station.
branches.outcome: Griffon regularly pays you a cut of caps from Aqua Cura sales.

Tell Griffon you know about his operation in Museum Authority and force him to shut it down.

title: Holy Water
summary: Investigating the disappearance of Megaton's water caravans: infiltrating the monastery of the Apostles of the Eternal Light in Springvale, where Mother Curie III's fanatics irradiate water to "convert" wastelanders into ghouls.
startCondition: Speak with Scribe Bigsley at the Jefferson Memorial, or find missionary Brother Gerard and a sect pamphlet outside Megaton's gates.
rewards: Reward from Scribe Bigsley and restored Aqua Pura deliveries to Megaton
Supply of "Holy Water" and rare chems from the monastery basement
missableWarnings: If you blew up Megaton during "The Power of the Atom", you can simply break the news to an astonished Scribe Bigsley — the quest will complete immediately!

steps.title: Find Brother Gerard along the road between Megaton and Springvale
steps.description: Search the outskirts of Megaton: pick up the missionary pamphlet from the dead caravan guard and speak with preacher Brother Gerard near the ruins of Springvale. To earn the cult's trust, drink the irradiated "Holy Water" he offers (or accumulate over 200 rads of radiation).

steps.title: Enter the Monastery of the Eternal Light beneath the Springvale house
steps.description: Once blessed by Gerard (or after forcing your way past the lock), descend into the basement of the ruined building in Springvale housing the Apostles of the Eternal Light, led by the Glowing One Mother Curie III (a former initiate of the Church of the Children of Atom).

steps.title: Stop the water contamination and report to Scribe Bigsley
steps.description: Speak with Mother Curie III about intercepting the Brotherhood of Steel's water caravans.

branches.label: Persuade Mother Curie III without bloodshed
branches.summary: Use a Speech or Science check to prove that forced irradiation kills people rather than granting them "enlightenment".
branches.outcome: The sect stops attacking Megaton's caravans peacefully; Bigsley pays the full reward.

branches.label: Eliminate the fanatics by force
branches.summary: Kill Mother Curie III and her followers in the monastery basement.
branches.outcome: The threat to the caravans is ended, you loot the sect's supplies, and you report back to Bigsley.

objectives.text: Investigate the Megaton area to clarify the water situation.
Investigate the Holy Water at the Monastery of the Eternal Light.
Drink the Holy Water.
Speak with Brother Gerard.
Gain entrance to the monastery.

Stop the Apostles of the Eternal Light.
Report to Bigsley.

title: The Local Flavor
summary: Voyaging aboard Tobar's riverboat to the swamps of Point Lookout, meeting the ghoul Desmond Lockhart, and defending historic Calvert Mansion against waves of savage swampfolk cultists.
startCondition: Pick up the quest "The Local Flavor" and speak with Catherine / Tobar at the Riverboat Landing on the Potomac River (southern edge of the map).
rewards: Access to Point Lookout
Alliance with Desmond Lockhart
missableWarnings: During the siege of Calvert Mansion, try to cover Desmond and plant mines at the breaches — he is a valuable ally.

steps.title: Buy a ticket for the Duchess Gambit riverboat
steps.description: Speak with mother Catherine, then buy a ticket (400 caps, or less with Speech) from Captain Tobar at the southern Wasteland pier.

steps.title: Calvert Mansion
steps.description: After arriving in Point Lookout, head to the old mansion on the hill. Desmond Lockhart lets you inside just as swamp tribals launch an assault.

steps.title: Repel three waves of attackers
steps.description: Defend the halls and rooms of the mansion alongside Desmond while he triggers a retaliatory blast from an explosive device.

objectives.text: Find out what is going on at the Riverboat Landing.
Purchase a ticket to Point Lookout.
Rest during the riverboat voyage.

The Lone Wanderer agreed to help Catherine search for her missing daughter Nadine in Point Lookout.
Spoke with ferryman Tobar about buying a ticket to Point Lookout.
Purchased a ticket aboard the Duchess Gambit to Point Lookout.
Rested in the riverboat's passenger cot during the voyage to the Maryland coast.
Arrived at Pilgrim's Landing in Point Lookout.

title: Walking With Spirits
summary: Desmond's assignment: infiltrate the tribal cult at the Cathedral of the Ark and Dove by enduring the psychedelic rite of Mother Punga.
startCondition: Speak with Desmond at Calvert Mansion after the siege.
rewards: "Punga Power!" perk (+10% Radiation Resistance / risky bonus)
Access to the Cathedral

steps.title: Reach the Cathedral of the Ark and Dove
steps.description: Speak with initiate Nadine (waiting at the entrance or inside) and cult leader Jackson.

steps.title: Gather seeds in the Sacred Bog
steps.description: Trek through the irradiated swamp to the grove, harvest Mother Punga seeds, and survive an intense hallucination (bringing your fears and past memories to life!).

steps.title: Return to the Cathedral
steps.description: After the vision fades, speak with Jackson to become an initiate.

objectives.text: Speak to Desmond about his offer.
Find out what the tribals at the Cathedral are up to.
Acquire seeds from the giant Mother Punga.
Return to the Cathedral.

Desmond Lockhart explained the terms of the tribals' trial in the Sacred Bog.

Harvested seeds from the giant Mother Punga deep in the Sacred Bog; spore-induced hallucinations begin.
The Lone Wanderer experiences visions in the bog, loses consciousness, and wakes up at the edge of the swamp.
Delivered the seeds to the Cathedral — the cultists accept you into their ranks, where Nadine greets you.
Initiation rite completed — advancing to the quest "Hearing Voices".

title: Hearing Voices
summary: Uncovering the secret of Point Lookout's tribal cult: at Desmond Lockhart's bidding and on Nadine's tip, you track high priest Jackson to a coastal Sea Cave and discover that the sect's "spirit" is a hologram of Professor Calvert's living brain.
startCondition: Begins automatically right after returning to the Cathedral of the Ark and Dove and completing the "Walking With Spirits" ritual.
rewards: Uncovering Professor Calvert's conspiracy and advancing to "Thought Control"
Loot from the Sea Cave and the cultists' stash
missableWarnings: In the Sea Cave, don't rush to attack Jackson immediately — wait until his conversation with the Brain hologram ends so you hear the full story of Calvert's manipulation!

steps.title: Question Nadine and the Cathedral cultists about Jackson's whereabouts
steps.description: Now a full member of the Cathedral of the Ark and Dove, speak with Nadine and the temple caretakers. You learn that cult leader Jackson regularly leaves to receive instructions from the "spirits" at a secluded Sea Cave along the eastern coast. Report this to Desmond Lockhart at the mansion.

steps.title: Navigate the Sea Cave to the hidden sanctum
steps.description: Travel to the Sea Cave on the ocean shore. Descend through winding stone tunnels past Mirelurks and hostile tribals until you reach an underground chamber housing a pre-War holographic projector.

steps.title: Eavesdrop on Jackson's talk with the Brain hologram and speak to Calvert
steps.description: Watch Jackson converse with the floating projection of a brain. Once Jackson leaves (or is slain by you), approach the projector: Professor Calvert himself addresses you—his living brain runs the cult from an underground lab—and offers to let you betray Desmond.

objectives.text: Find out where the tribal leader is.
Return to Desmond and tell him what you learned.
Find out more about the tribal leader.
Find out more about the Brain.

Learned from Nadine and the cultists that sect leader Jackson went to the Sea Cave.
Desmond Lockhart tasked you with tracking Jackson into the coastal caves.
Found Jackson inside the Sea Cave speaking with a holographic projection of a brain.
Jackson's secret conversation with Professor Calvert's hologram has ended.

Professor Calvert's Brain offers the Lone Wanderer a chance to work against Desmond.

title: Thought Control
summary: Psychic warfare between Calvert and Desmond: planting or destroying a telepathic jammer on the Ferris wheel, taking revenge on ferryman Tobar for stealing a piece of your brain, and the bombing of Calvert Mansion.
startCondition: Begins immediately after speaking with the hologram of Professor Calvert's brain in the Sea Cave.
rewards: Reclaiming (or disposing of) your stolen brain fragment and Tobar's Captain's Hat
Full control of the Duchess Gambit riverboat for free travel between the Capital Wasteland and Point Lookout
missableWarnings: Inside Tobar's quarters on the riverboat, be sure to inspect the shelves of extracted brain lumps and pick up your own specimen along with the captain's cabin key!

steps.title: Deal with the psychic jammer on the Ferris wheel
steps.description: Professor Calvert demands you destroy Desmond's jamming device at the top of the Pilgrim's Landing Ferris wheel, while Desmond asks you to install and protect it. As you approach the ride, Calvert starts beaming telepathic impulses directly into your skull through your surgical scar!

branches.label: Toss the emitter into the garbage chute (in Desmond's favor)
branches.summary: Hide or protect the jamming device from the tribals.
branches.outcome: Calvert's telepathic signal is weakened before the final showdown.

branches.label: Destroy the emitter on the Ferris wheel (on Calvert's orders)
branches.summary: Blow up Desmond's jamming device at the top of the ride.
branches.outcome: Calvert retains the full power of his psychic transmitter.

steps.title: Search the riverboat's engine room and kill ferryman Tobar
steps.description: Realizing that Tobar performed trepanation on you while you were unconscious aboard the riverboat, head back to the Duchess Gambit. Descend into the locked corridor past the sleeping quarters, eliminate the cleaver-wielding Tobar, and take the jar containing your own brain fragment off the table.

steps.title: Rush to Calvert Mansion after the explosion
steps.description: Stepping off the riverboat onto the pier, you witness Calvert remotely blowing up his ancestral mansion with Desmond inside. Make your way to the smoking ruins, where a miraculously surviving Desmond opens a secret hatch into the underground lighthouse complex.

objectives.text: Speak to Desmond.
Install the jamming device on the Ferris wheel.

Return to the mansion.

title: A Meeting Of The Minds
summary: Showdown of a century-old rivalry beneath the Point Lookout Lighthouse (Desmond Lockhart's path): descending into the secret biolab beneath the lighthouse, fighting past security robots, and destroying the tank holding Professor Calvert's brain.
startCondition: Follow Desmond Lockhart down into the underground bunker beneath the ruined mansion and Point Lookout Lighthouse.
rewards: "Ghoul Ecology" perk (+5 damage with any weapon) and access to the lab's artifact vault
Unique Microwave Emitter (energy weapon that ignores armor!), Desmond's Eyeglasses, and ammunition from the safe
missableWarnings: Don't forget to grab the unique Microwave Emitter from the armory vault in the side wing of the underground lab before heading back to the surface!

steps.title: Fight through the underground complex to the lighthouse with Desmond
steps.description: Push through the service tunnels beneath the ruined mansion into the secret research bunker beneath the Point Lookout Lighthouse. Help Desmond destroy turrets, security bots, and Professor Calvert's combat Robobrains.

steps.title: Enter the central dome housing Calvert's brain tank
steps.description: When you reach the main laboratory dome, Professor Calvert makes one last attempt to win you over to his side, while Desmond demands you shatter his nemesis's armored jar immediately.

steps.title: Shatter Calvert's brain jar and open the armory vault
steps.description: Open fire on the glass life-support sphere holding Professor Calvert's brain until it shatters. Afterward, speak with a triumphant Desmond Lockhart (who unlocks the coded vault door containing the unique Microwave Emitter and ammo) and decide whether to mention Nadine as the new riverboat captain.
steps.tip: If you wish, after unlocking the vault you can eliminate Desmond as well to claim his unique eyeglasses (+5 Small Guns, +5 Explosives).

Return to Desmond when ready.

title: A Meeting Of The Minds
summary: The alternate finale in the underground lighthouse bunker (Professor Calvert's path): eliminating Desmond Lockhart on the Brain's orders, Calvert's inevitable betrayal, and battling his security robots.
startCondition: In the central chamber of the underground lighthouse lab, side with Professor Calvert's brain and attack Desmond Lockhart.
rewards: Desmond's Eyeglasses (+5 Small Guns, +5 Explosives) and his weapons from his corpse
Access to the lab's treasure vault containing the unique Microwave Emitter
missableWarnings: Professor Calvert will betray you the instant Desmond dies, activating combat robots and ceiling turrets in the chamber — have Pulse Grenades or heavy firepower ready!

steps.title: Turn your weapons on Desmond Lockhart in the main chamber
steps.description: After hearing both pre-War rivals issue their ultimatum before the brain tank, open fire on Desmond Lockhart. Keep in mind that Desmond is heavily armed and makes full use of cover in the lab chamber.

steps.title: Survive the sudden robot ambush after Calvert's betrayal
steps.description: The moment Desmond falls, the arrogant Professor Calvert announces he has no further use for a "wasteland savage," seals the exits, and unleashes his security bots and ceiling turrets on you.

steps.title: Destroy Calvert's brain tank and claim the bunker's loot
steps.description: Evade the robot fire, shoot the armored glass tank containing Calvert's own brain, loot the eyeglasses and key from Desmond's body, and unlock the vault with the unique Microwave Emitter before taking the elevator up to the top of the lighthouse.

objectives.text: Head to the lighthouse.
Find Desmond and stop him.

title: An Antique Land
summary: Expedition to the wreck of the pre-War research vessel USS Ozymandias: collecting geological survey data from three swamp drill sites around the rig to unlock a medical safe stocked with Bio-Gel.
startCondition: Activate the working terminal aboard the half-buried ship at the "Ozymandias" Wreck in central Point Lookout.
rewards: Access to the locked vault aboard the Ozymandias containing Adapted and Pure Bio-Gel, Stimpaks, Rad-X, and Med-X
XP and insight into the pre-War drilling operations in the Maryland swamps
missableWarnings: Extracting data tapes at each of the three soil survey sites draws packs of enraged Mirelurks out of the water — keep a shotgun or mines at the ready!

steps.title: Activate the terminal at the Ozymandias Wreck
steps.description: Deep in the swamps of Point Lookout, locate the fenced-off excavation pit holding the hull of the research vessel Ozymandias. Head down into the ship's interior compartment, read Sylvia's expedition logs on the main terminal, and initiate the geological sampling protocol to mark 3 survey sites on your map.

steps.title: Collect data from the three soil survey sites
steps.description: Visit Soil Survey Site #01, #02, and #03 in turn across the flooded peat bogs around the drilling rig. At each site, activate the field data-logging terminal and fend off the Mirelurks emerging from the marsh.

steps.title: Upload the results to the ship's computer and open the safe
steps.description: Return to the hold of the Ozymandias and feed all three data packages into the lab terminal. The automated system unlocks the armored vault door, revealing crates stocked with rare pre-War/alien Bio-Gel and medical supplies.

objectives.text: Locate Soil Survey Site #01.
Locate Soil Survey Site #02.
Locate Soil Survey Site #03.
Feed data into research vessel terminal.

title: Companion Recruitment: Dogmeat
summary: Recruit the loyal hound Dogmeat at the Scrapyard: the Capital Wasteland's most faithful four-legged companion follows the Lone Wanderer regardless of Karma and can scavenge for supplies alongside a humanoid follower.
startCondition: Travel to the Scrapyard, located south of Minefield and northeast of the Car Dealership.
rewards: Permanent companion Dogmeat (occupies a separate animal slot and travels alongside any second companion!)
Scavenges for weapons, ammo, chems, and food on voice command
missableWarnings: With the Broken Steel add-on installed, Dogmeat's health scales with your level up to 15,000 HP, and at level 22 you can take the "Puppies!" perk so that if Dogmeat dies, one of his puppies will always appear outside Vault 101.

steps.title: Reach the Scrapyard south of Minefield
steps.description: Head northeast from Megaton across the bridge toward the Scrapyard (just south of Minefield). Push deeper into the maze of rusted buses and wrecked car frames, following the sound of gunfire and barking.

steps.title: Eliminate the raiders who killed Dogmeat's previous owner
steps.description: In the center of the Scrapyard, near the corpse of a slain wastelander, Dogmeat is fighting three raiders single-handedly. Help him wipe out the bandits while taking care not to hit Dogmeat with stray gunfire or explosives.

steps.title: Recruit Dogmeat and use his scavenging commands
steps.description: Approach the dog once he calms down, speak to him, and invite him to come along. In dialogue with Dogmeat, you can order him at any time to search the area for ammo, weapons, Stimpaks, or food (he can even retrieve items from locked containers!).
steps.tip: If you dismiss Dogmeat or tell him to wait for too long, he will return to the entrance of Vault 101.

title: The Dark Heart of Blackhall
summary: A Lovecraftian gothic mystery in "The Dark Heart of Blackhall": aristocrat Obadiah Blackhall hires you to recover an ancient family heirloom from swamp cultists—a sinister occult grimoire known as the Krivbeknih, which the missionary Marcella is also hunting.
startCondition: Speak with Obadiah Blackhall at Blackhall Manor (in southwestern Point Lookout).
rewards: 1,000 caps (2,000 caps with a Speech check) and a unique ritual melee weapon if you give the book to Obadiah Blackhall
Or +300 Good Karma and cleansing of the curse if you destroy the Krivbeknih at the obelisk inside the Dunwich Building back in the Capital Wasteland
missableWarnings: If you hand the Krivbeknih over to Obadiah Blackhall and then sneak into his hidden basement, you can witness his occult sacrifice ritual and claim the unique Ritual Knife (and still take the book afterward to destroy it in the Dunwich Building!).

steps.title: Accept Obadiah Blackhall's contract and speak with Marcella
steps.description: At Blackhall Manor, hear out Obadiah's request to recover his stolen "family book" from the tribals. On your way into the swamps, stop by the Disaster Relief Outpost tent camp along the coast, where the missionary Marcella reveals that the tome is actually the cursed Krivbeknih and asks you to bring it to her to be destroyed.

steps.title: Retrieve the Krivbeknih from the altar at the Ritual Site
steps.description: Make your way northeast into the fog-shrouded Ritual Site, guarded by the deadliest swampfolk and brutes. Clear out the ring of huts, descend into the subterranean shrine beneath the main totem, and take the human-skin-bound Krivbeknih from the bone lectern.
steps.tip: As soon as you take the book from the altar, a fresh wave of fanatics will descend from above—rig the stairs with mines beforehand!

steps.title: Investigate Marcella's death at her camp
steps.description: If you decide to bring the book to Marcella, you will return to the Disaster Relief Outpost to find that the missionary has been murdered by smugglers. Listen to her dying holotape, "Marcella's Last Words": she begs you to carry the Krivbeknih back to the Capital Wasteland and burn it at the dark obelisk beneath the Dunwich Building.

steps.title: Decide the fate of the cursed tome: Blackhall Manor or the Dunwich Building
steps.description: Resolve the story along one of two paths.

branches.label: Destroy the Krivbeknih at the Dunwich Building obelisk (Good path)
branches.summary: Take the ferry back to the Capital Wasteland, descend into the Virulent Underchambers beneath the Dunwich Building (in the southwest corner of the map), and place the book upon the black monolith.
branches.outcome: The obelisk erupts in flame and incinerates the Krivbeknih, granting you a large amount of Good Karma.

branches.label: Sell the book to Obadiah Blackhall (Evil / Cunning path)
branches.summary: Deliver the tome to Obadiah at Blackhall Manor for 1,000–2,000 caps.
branches.outcome: Obadiah opens a secret passage behind the bust in his bedroom and begins a sacrifice in the crypt (where you can kill him, loot the Ritual Knife, and still take the book to the Dunwich Building!).

objectives.text: Obtain the Blackhall family book from the Ritual Site.
Obtain the Krivbeknih from the Ritual Site.
Deliver the Blackhall family book to Obadiah.
Deliver the Krivbeknih to Obadiah OR Marcella.
Deliver the Krivbeknih to Marcella.
Investigate the circumstances of Marcella's death.
Take the Krivbeknih to the Dunwich Building in the Capital Wasteland.
Take the Krivbeknih to Obadiah OR take it to the Dunwich Building in the Capital Wasteland.

title: A Spoonful of Whiskey
summary: Moonshining in the Point Lookout swamps ("A Spoonful of Whiskey"): cunning hermit Marguerite fakes a debilitating illness in her shack to trick travelers into gathering yeast, fission batteries, and punga fruit to get her still running.
startCondition: Enter the Moonshiner Shack on the southern edge of the Point Lookout swamps and speak with Marguerite in bed.
rewards: A batch of Marguerite's unique Moonshine (+2 Strength, +2 Charisma, +10 HP!) and the ability to collect fresh bottles regularly
XP and a reduced ingredient list if you see through her ruse
missableWarnings: Use Medicine 40, Science 40, Barter 40, or Perception 7 in dialogue with Marguerite—if you call her out on faking her illness, you will NOT have to track down 24 bottles of Purified Water, and she will only ask for half as much punga fruit!

steps.title: Speak with Marguerite and expose her fake illness
steps.description: In the wooden shack northeast of Calvert Mansion, you will find Marguerite groaning in bed and asking for ingredients for a "healing tonic." Pass a Medicine, Science, Barter, or Perception check to realize she is perfectly healthy and simply brewing swamp moonshine for profit.
steps.tip: If you successfully call her bluff, Marguerite drops the 24 bottles of Purified Water from the list and settles for 10 refined punga fruit (or 20 wild) instead of double.

steps.title: Gather yeast, fission batteries, and punga fruit
steps.description: Scavenge Point Lookout's swamps and abandoned shops (such as the coastal seafood shop and smuggler camps) for 3 packs of yeast, 6 fission batteries, and 10 refined punga fruit (grown at the Ark & Dove Cathedral; alternatively, collect 20 wild punga fruit in the bog).

steps.title: Deliver the ingredients and collect your moonshine after 24 hours
steps.description: Hand all the supplies over to Marguerite: she immediately hops out of bed and fires up the still out front. Wait 24 in-game hours and return to claim your first free batch of potent Moonshine (she will continue producing new bottles for you periodically).

objectives.text: Bring Marguerite ten refined punga fruit or twenty wild punga fruit.
Bring Marguerite three bags of yeast.
Bring Marguerite 24 bottles of Purified Water.
Bring Marguerite six fission batteries.
Collect the moonshine from Marguerite when it's ready.

logs: Marguerite asked me to gather ingredients (yeast, punga fruit, and fission batteries) for her signature moonshine.
Marguerite started up the still—I can return in 24 hours to pick up a finished batch of moonshine.

title: Companion Recruitment: Jericho
summary: Recruit retired raider Jericho in Megaton: the grizzled Capital Wasteland veteran will only come out of retirement to travel with an Evil-Karma character for a 1,000-cap signing bonus.
startCondition: Speak with Jericho on the streets of Megaton, inside his house, or at Moriarty's Saloon while having Evil Karma and 1,000 caps.
rewards: Companion Jericho (armed with a Chinese Assault Rifle with infinite 5.56mm ammo; Small Guns specialist)
Strong early-game combat support for characters with Evil Karma
missableWarnings: If you detonate Megaton during "The Power of the Atom" BEFORE recruiting Jericho, he will die in the nuclear blast!

steps.title: Track down Jericho in Megaton
steps.description: Jericho lives in his own shack on Megaton's middle tier (near Moriarty's Saloon) and patrols the town in leather armor during the day. Ask him about his raider past and offer to take him out into the wasteland.

steps.title: Ensure you have Evil Karma and 1,000 caps
steps.description: Jericho refuses to work with "do-gooders": to recruit him, your Karma must be negative (Evil or worse), and you must pay him 1,000 caps "for cigarettes and traveling expenses."
steps.tip: An easy way to lower Karma early on is hacking owned terminals or stealing low-value items in Megaton or Tenpenny Tower.

steps.title: Pay his fee and gear up your new companion
steps.description: Hand Jericho 1,000 caps and he will join your party immediately. He is deadly with his default Chinese Assault Rifle (without consuming your ammo) and will gladly equip any combat or power armor you give him.

title: Latchkey Kenny
summary: Befriend the orphaned boy Kenny inside the abandoned Herzog Mine: play games of tag and hide-and-seek through the mine tunnels, gift him a teddy bear, and earn a permanent safe haven to rest in Point Lookout.
startCondition: Descend into Herzog Mine in central Point Lookout and make your way to the inhabited cavern deep inside the mine.
rewards: Unique "Kenny-Bear" and access to an ammunition stash
A safe bed and friendly player hideout in the heart of Point Lookout
missableWarnings: Watch out for tripwires, bear traps, and rigged cave-ins along the upper tunnels of Herzog Mine that Kenny set up to keep swampfolk out!

steps.title: Bypass the traps in Herzog Mine and find Kenny's cavern
steps.description: Enter the old Herzog Mine just north of the Cathedral. Disarm the makeshift traps through the upper drifts until you reach a well-lit underground hideout where a young orphan named Kenny lives all alone.

steps.title: Play tag and hide-and-seek with Kenny
steps.description: Ask Kenny about what happened to his parents and agree to play with him. You can play tag with him (chasing him across the cavern catwalks and fleeing when he's "it") or play hide-and-seek in the mine's side tunnels.

steps.title: Give him a teddy bear and gain access to Kenny's cave
steps.description: Bring the lonely boy a Teddy Bear (or choose kind dialogue options). Touched by your friendship, Kenny declares you his best friend, lets you sleep in his bed and store gear in his cave, and even lets you take his prized "Kenny-Bear."
