Hide-and-seek: The Lone Wanderer hides while Kenny searches.

title: Companion Recruitment: Charon
summary: Buy out the contract of ghoul bodyguard Charon at The Ninth Circle in Underworld: armed with a uniquely accurate shotgun, the fearless enforcer obeys whoever holds his employment contract, regardless of Karma.
startCondition: Visit The Ninth Circle bar in the ghoul city of Underworld (inside the Museum of History on The Mall) and speak with bartender Ahzrukhal.
rewards: Permanent companion Charon (follows you regardless of Karma!)
Charon's unique long-range Combat Shotgun and knife, plus whatever you loot from Ahzrukhal's body
missableWarnings: Immediately upon receiving his contract, Charon coldly executes his former master Ahzrukhal—if you want to buy rare chems or schematics from Ahzrukhal, do so BEFORE buying out the contract!

steps.title: Locate Ahzrukhal and Charon inside The Ninth Circle
steps.description: Enter the Museum of History on The Mall, pass through the mammoth skull into Underworld, and head upstairs to The Ninth Circle bar. The towering ghoul bouncer Charon stands motionless near the entrance while his employer, Ahzrukhal, tends the bar.

steps.title: Buy the contract with caps or eliminate Greta
steps.description: Ask Ahzrukhal about acquiring Charon's contract. He offers two ways to close the deal: pay cash up front, or quietly murder his business rival—Greta, the cook at Carol's Place.

branches.label: Purchase the contract with caps (Good / Neutral path)
branches.summary: Pay Ahzrukhal 2,000 caps (or 1,000 caps with a Barter skill of 50 or higher).
branches.outcome: The contract transfers to you without murdering an innocent resident of Underworld.

branches.label: Assassinate Greta for Ahzrukhal (Evil path)
branches.summary: Ambush Greta outside Carol's Place and eliminate her.
branches.outcome: You receive Charon's contract for free, at the cost of Karma and Underworld's cook.

steps.title: Give the contract to Charon and bring him into your party
steps.description: Approach Charon and hand him the contract you acquired. Freed from serving the hated bartender, Charon immediately executes Ahzrukhal with his sniper-accurate Combat Shotgun and pledges his loyalty to you.
steps.tip: Charon makes great use of Power Armor (including T-51b and Enclave armor) and stays loyal whether you play as a saint or a villain.

title: The Velvet Curtain
summary: A pre-War espionage thriller in "The Velvet Curtain": uncover the botched mission of Chinese intelligence agents Yang and Chen in Point Lookout, infiltrate Turtledove Detention Camp, scuttle the stranded submarine SSN-37-1A, and escape a hidden bunker with the unique Backwater Rifle.
startCondition: Enter Room 1D of the Homestead Motel along the Point Lookout boardwalk and activate the terminal beside the Chinese agent's skeleton.
rewards: Unique lever-action Backwater Rifle (10mm caliber, 5x critical hit multiplier!)
Chinese jumpsuits, caps, Stealth Boys, and Lockpick/Science opportunities in the bunker terminals
missableWarnings: Be sure to grab the unique Backwater Rifle from the wall rack inside the final secret bunker BEFORE the poisonous gas trap countdown begins!

steps.title: Search Motel Room 1D, the pier locker, and Bank Box 1207
steps.description: In Room 1D of the Homestead Motel, read the terminal logs, grab the locker key from the dresser beside the skeleton, and open the storage locker out on Pilgrim's Landing. Take the voice-password holotape to the People's Bank of Point Lookout, unlock Safety Deposit Box 1207, and listen to the orders to purge all evidence.

steps.title: Find Agent Yang's remains at Turtledove Detention Camp
steps.description: Travel to the abandoned pre-War Turtledove Detention Camp, patrolled by robots and feral ghouls. Check the interrogation logs in the guard barracks, then dig up the unmarked grave along the back fence to recover the Chinese submarine access codes from Agent Yang's corpse.

steps.title: Trigger the self-destruct on Submarine SSN-37-1A
steps.description: Make your way to the hidden coastal cove in the southwest corner of the map where the Chinese stealth submarine SSN-37-1A lies beached. Board it using Yang's codes, initiate the self-destruct sequence in the control room, flip the backup lever in the torpedo bay, and sprint out before the vessel explodes.

steps.title: Unlock the secret bunker with Cryptochromatic Spectacles and escape the trap
steps.description: Return to the Room 1D terminal, retrieve the Cryptochromatic Spectacles hidden inside the toilet tank, and put them on in front of the statue across from the amusement park to reveal the color sequence for the hidden bunker hatch (red, blue, yellow, green). Downstairs, grab the unique Backwater Rifle off the wall, activate the extraction terminal, and pick or hack the side ventilation grate to escape when the carbon monoxide trap engages!

objectives.text: Investigate Motel Room 1D, where the spy stayed.
Search Room 1D for the Chinese spy's locker key.
Find the Chinese spy's mission brief in a locker in Point Lookout.
Use the password holotape to open Safety Deposit Box 1207 at the Point Lookout bank.
Listen to the tape of the spy's instructions.
Find leads to learn the fate of Agent Yang.
Learn Agent Yang's fate by visiting Turtledove Detention Camp.
Activate the Chinese submarine's self-destruct mechanism.
Confirm the self-destruct order by turning the auxiliary control lever.
Flee the submarine before it self-destructs.
Return to the motel terminal for further instructions.
Retrieve the Cryptochromatic Spectacles from the toilet tank in Room 1D.
Use the Cryptochromatic Spectacles and code to access the secret bunker.
Learn the details of the spy's extraction plan and claim your reward in the secret bunker.
Escape from the trap!

title: Companion Recruitment: Sergeant RL-3
summary: Purchase the pre-War military Mister Gutsy robot Sergeant RL-3 from traveling merchant Tinker Joe: a formidable hovering companion armed with a plasma weapon and flamer for characters with Neutral Karma.
startCondition: Meet robot vendor Tinker Joe outside the RobCo Facility (north of Tenpenny Tower) while having Neutral Karma and 1,000 caps.
rewards: Combat robot companion Sergeant RL-3 (equipped with a built-in plasma rifle and flamer)
High durability (scales up to 9,500 HP with Broken Steel)
missableWarnings: Tinker Joe will ONLY sell you Sergeant RL-3 if your current Karma is strictly Neutral—adjust your Karma through theft or cap donations beforehand if needed!

steps.title: Intercept Tinker Joe near the RobCo Facility
steps.description: Head to the southwest portion of the map toward the RobCo Facility (between Tenpenny Tower and Megaton). Merchant Tinker Joe patrols the road heading north from the RobCo entrance accompanied by Sergeant RL-3 and two protectron guards.

steps.title: Balance your Karma to Neutral
steps.description: Before initiating dialogue, check your Pip-Boy stats screen to ensure your Karma reads "Neutral." If you are too Good, steal a few empty bottles inside someone's home; if too Evil, donate caps to the Church of the Children of Atom in Megaton.

steps.title: Buy Sergeant RL-3 for 1,000 caps
steps.description: Speak with Tinker Joe and pay 1,000 caps to have Sergeant RL-3 reprogrammed to follow your orders. The gung-ho military robot joins your squad immediately and will remain loyal even if your Karma shifts Good or Evil later on.
steps.tip: If you temporarily dismiss Sergeant RL-3, he will wait for you in the center of Canterbury Commons.

title: Companion Recruitment: Clover
summary: Purchase bodyguard Clover from slaver boss Eulogy Jones in Paradise Falls: the fanatically loyal slave follows only a character with Evil Karma.
startCondition: Gain entry to Paradise Falls and speak with Eulogy Jones in his mansion pad while having Evil Karma.
rewards: Permanent companion Clover (specializes in Melee Weapons and Small Guns)
missableWarnings: If you kill Eulogy Jones during an assault on Paradise Falls (such as "Rescue from Paradise") before buying Clover, you will lose the chance to recruit her!

steps.title: Gain access to Paradise Falls and find Eulogy Jones
steps.description: Enter the slaver compound of Paradise Falls (by taking Grouse's assignment "Strictly Business" or paying 500 caps at the gate) and walk to the rear building, Eulogy's Pad, where camp leader Eulogy Jones resides with his slaves Clover and Crimson.

steps.title: Negotiate Clover's purchase with Evil Karma
steps.description: Make sure your Karma is negative, then ask Eulogy Jones about buying Clover. He will agree to part with his favorite bodyguard for 1,000 caps.
steps.tip: Passing a Speech or Barter check cuts Clover's price in half—from 1,000 caps down to 500 caps.

steps.title: Equip Clover for close- and mid-range combat
steps.description: Right after payment, Clover enters your service. By default she carries a Chinese Officer's Sword and a Sawed-Off Shotgun, so be sure to outfit her with sturdy armor and a strong rifle or Ripper.

title: Plik's Safari
summary: The bloody attraction of "Plik's Safari" inside a Point Lookout sea cave: eccentric ghoul hunter Plik charges 1,000 caps to test your mettle in an underground arena against waves of frenzied feral ghouls and glowing ones.
startCondition: Find the Coastal Grotto on Point Lookout's northeastern shore, descend into the cave, and talk to the ghoul Plik.
rewards: Unique two-handed axe "The Dismemberer" from the trophy table upon victory
Plik's Journal and a unique Gatling Laser/gear if you choose to take them
missableWarnings: Up to a dozen fast-moving Feral Ghoul Reavers and Glowing Ones rush the arena at once—if you are playing at high level with Broken Steel, bring the Ghoul Mask or plenty of mines and a Combat Shotgun!

steps.title: Pay Plik 1,000 caps to enter the safari
steps.description: Descend into the Coastal Grotto in northeastern Point Lookout, where the ghoul Plik runs a private hunting club. Pay the 1,000-cap entry fee so he unlocks the gate into the subterranean arena.

steps.title: Enter the arena, hit the siren switch, and survive the ghoul waves
steps.description: Step into the chain-link enclosure (laying Frag Mines and Bottlecap Mines in front of the side pens beforehand) and press the red signal button on the central pillar. Multiple waves of feral ghouls, roamers, and glowing ones pour from the cages—kill every last one.
steps.tip: If you wear the Ghoul Mask from the "Tenpenny Tower" quest, even the ghouls inside Plik's arena will not attack you first!

steps.title: Return to Plik and claim the unique axe "The Dismemberer"
steps.description: Once the final ghoul falls and the arena gate reopens, report your survival to an amazed Plik. As your grand prize, the lock releases on the unique fire axe "The Dismemberer" mounted on his trophy wall.

objectives.text: Pay Plik 1,000 caps—the entry fee for the safari.
Step onto the floor and signal Plik to begin the safari.
Survive Plik's Safari.
Let Plik know you survived.

title: Companion Recruitment: Butch DeLoria
summary: Reunite with childhood acquaintance and Tunnel Snakes leader Butch DeLoria at the Rivet City bar: after resolving the crisis in Vault 101, Butch heads out to the surface and is willing to travel with a Neutral-Karma Lone Wanderer.
startCondition: Complete the side quest "Trouble on the Homefront" (MS16) with Butch alive, then find him in The Muddy Rudder bar in Rivet City while maintaining Neutral Karma.
rewards: Free companion Butch DeLoria
Free haircuts for your character out in the field at any time
missableWarnings: Butch ONLY appears in Rivet City after you return to Vault 101 for "Trouble on the Homefront" and keep him alive!

steps.title: Meet Butch during "Trouble on the Homefront"
steps.description: After returning to Vault 101 in response to Amata's distress call (quest MS16), talk to Butch DeLoria in the living quarters. He dreams of escaping to the Capital Wasteland and starting a surface branch of the Tunnel Snakes.

steps.title: Track down Butch in The Muddy Rudder in Rivet City
steps.description: Once the Vault 101 quest concludes, travel to the lower deck of the Rivet City aircraft carrier and enter The Muddy Rudder saloon. You will find Butch sitting at a table in his signature Tunnel Snakes leather jacket.

steps.title: Recruit Butch while maintaining Neutral Karma
steps.description: As long as your Karma is Neutral, Butch gladly joins you free of charge. Beyond backing you up in firefights, he can cut or restyle your hair into the classic Tunnel Snakes look whenever you ask.
steps.tip: Since Butch starts out with only Butch's Toothpick (a switchblade) and a 10mm Pistol, hand him decent armor and a stronger firearm.

title: Not of This World
summary: Abducted by a tractor beam from the Alien Crash Site aboard the massive flagship Mothership Zeta: break out of the holding cell with raider Somah and young Sally, recover your gear, and overload the reactor in the Engineering Core.
startCondition: Pick up the Recon Craft Theta radio signal north of Greener Pastures Disposal Site and MDPL-13 Power Station and approach the crashed UFO.
rewards: Alien energy weapons (Alien Atomizer, Alien Disintegrator, Shock Baton) and Alien Biogel
Allies freed from cryogenic stasis: U.S. Army medic Elliott Tercorien, samurai Toshiro Kago, and cowboy Paulson
missableWarnings: WARNING: There are 25 Alien Captive Recorded Logs hidden aboard Mothership Zeta (collecting all 25 grants the "Xenotech Expert" perk for +20% damage with alien weapons). Logs #19 (in the Steamworks tunnel before the Engineering Core) and those in the Cryo Lab can ONLY be grabbed during the main story—after the finale, those sections are permanently sealed!

steps.title: Stage a brawl with Somah and escape the holding cell
steps.description: After waking up from alien experiments inside an energy cell alongside a woman named Somah, agree to fake a fistfight with her. When two aliens armed with shock batons drop the force field to break it up, kill the guards and free young Sally from the neighboring cell.

steps.title: Recover your equipment in the storage room
steps.description: Follow Sally through the air ducts and detention block corridors to the evidence room. Open the chest in front of the observation window to reclaim all your weapons and armor, and grab your first Alien Atomizers and Disintegrators.

steps.title: Revive Elliott, samurai Toshiro Kago, and cowboy Paulson from stasis
steps.description: Push through the Steamworks tunnel (don't miss Alien Captive Recorded Log #19!) to reach the ship's Engineering Core. Activate the consoles on the four cryo pods to thaw U.S. Army field medic Elliott Tercorien (from Anchorage, 2077), 16th-century Japanese samurai Toshiro Kago, and Old West gunslinger Paulson.

steps.title: Overload the generator in the Engine Room
steps.description: Head into the Engine Room off the Engineering Core, raise the three cooling conduits on the generator one by one, and shoot them down under fire from aliens and drones to knock out the internal bulkheads and open access to the rest of the ship.

objectives.text: Investigate the strange radio signal coming from somewhere in the wasteland.
Find a way to escape from the cell.
Start a fight with Somah to draw the guards' attention.
Eliminate the guards.
Retrieve your gear.
Continue searching for an exit from the detention block.
Free Sally from her cell.
Reach the alien ship's Engineering Core.
(Optional) Free the other prisoners from their cells.

title: Companion Recruitment: Star Paladin Cross
summary: Recruit Brotherhood of Steel veteran Star Paladin Cross at the Citadel: the cyborg bodyguard who once escorted your father James and you as an infant to Vault 101 joins a Good-Karma Lone Wanderer free of charge.
startCondition: Reach the Citadel during the main quest "The Waters of Life" (MQ05) and speak with Star Paladin Cross in the Laboratory or the A Ring while having Good Karma.
rewards: Free elite companion Star Paladin Cross in full Brotherhood Power Armor
Skilled in Energy Weapons and Melee Weapons (armed with a Super Sledge and Laser Pistol)
missableWarnings: Cross requires Good Karma not only when you first recruit her, but also whenever you re-hire her after dismissing her—keep your Karma positive!

steps.title: Locate Star Paladin Cross in the Citadel Laboratory
steps.description: After arriving at the Citadel and speaking with Elder Owyn Lyons (during "The Waters of Life"), find Star Paladin Cross inside the Laboratory hall or patrolling the corridors of the A Ring.

steps.title: Ask Cross about your father James's past
steps.description: Talk to Cross about how she guarded your father James and you twenty years ago on the trek from the Jefferson Memorial to the doors of Vault 101. Learning of James's heroic sacrifice, she feels duty-bound to watch over you.

steps.title: Recruit Star Paladin Cross with Good Karma
steps.description: If your Karma is positive, Cross will join you at no cost. She already wears Brotherhood Power Armor and crushes enemies up close with a Super Sledge—handing her a Gatling Laser or Plasma Rifle turns her into an even deadlier ranged fighter.

title: Among the Stars
summary: Sabotage three vital wings aboard Mothership Zeta: destroy the generators in the Cryo Lab, the Hangar (housing the Valkyrie), and Robot Assembly, salvage drone parts to repair the teleporter, and take a Space Walk across the ship's hull.
startCondition: Speak with Sally and your rescued allies in the Engineering Core after overloading the main engine.
rewards: Unique alien weaponry ("Captain's Sidearm," plus Cryo Grenades and Cryo Mines crafted by Elliott Tercorien)
Alien Spacesuit and a Space Walk outside the hull overlooking Earth
missableWarnings: BE SURE to collect all Alien Captive Recorded Logs in the Cryo Lab, Cargo Hold, Biological Research, and Robot Assembly BEFORE putting on the spacesuit and stepping out into space—once you do, the doors to those wings from the Engineering Core lock permanently!

steps.title: Destroy the generators in the Cryo Lab and Robot Assembly
steps.description: From the Engineering Core, fight your way through the Cryo Lab (bring medic Elliott along—he can craft Cryo Grenades and Cryo Mines for you!) and Robot Assembly (alongside Somah). At the end of each wing, raise the generator shielding and destroy all three power nodes.
steps.tip: While clearing Robot Assembly, be sure to loot 3 intact Drone Control Devices from destroyed Support Drones—you will need them to repair the teleporter!

steps.title: Blow the Hangar generator and repel the counterattack in the Engineering Core
steps.description: Fight alongside cowboy Paulson up to the catwalk of the massive Hangar where an alien fighter craft sits, trigger the hangar reactor overload, and destroy the third generator. Return to the Engineering Core and help your allies hold off an alien assault squad.

steps.title: Ascend through the Decompression Chamber and equip the Spacesuit
steps.description: Use the salvaged drone parts to fix the teleporter to the Maintenance Level and enter the Decompression Chamber. Search the fallen Vault 108 officer's corpse, put on the airtight Spacesuit, and cycle the airlock.

steps.title: Cross Mothership Zeta's exterior hull on a Space Walk
steps.description: Step out onto the ship's hull high in Earth's orbit! Moving beneath the protective force-field dome, activate the three exterior junction boxes in sequence to power the teleporter to the weapons deck and the Bridge.

objectives.text: Revive the humans from stasis.
Talk to Sally.
Destroy the Cryo Lab generator.
(Optional) Ask the humans you rescued for help.
Destroy the Hangar generator.
Destroy the Robot Assembly generator.
Talk to Sally.
Make your way to the upper level of the alien ship.
Find a way to activate the teleporter.

logs: Maintenance Level teleporter activated aboard Mothership Zeta.

title: Companion Recruitment: Fawkes
summary: Recruit the intelligent super mutant Fawkes after escaping Enclave headquarters at Raven Rock: the strongest and toughest companion in Fallout 3, armed with an unlimited Gatling Laser and completely immune to radiation.
startCondition: Free Fawkes from Isolation Room 5 in Vault 87 during "Finding the Garden of Eden" (MQ08), then meet him outside the Raven Rock exit at the end of "The American Dream" (MQ09) with Good Karma.
rewards: Powerhouse companion Fawkes with an unlimited Gatling Laser and Super Sledge
Option to send Fawkes into the irradiated Project Purity chamber during the "Take it Back!" finale (with Broken Steel installed)
missableWarnings: For Fawkes to come to your rescue outside Raven Rock, you MUST release him from Isolation Room 5 in Vault 87 while searching for the G.E.C.K.!

steps.title: Free Fawkes in the Vault 87 Test Labs
steps.description: During the main quest "Finding the Garden of Eden" in the Vault 87 experimentation wing, release the friendly super mutant Fawkes from Isolation Room 5 (by triggering the fire alarm on the terminal or finding the key). In gratitude, he retrieves the G.E.C.K. for you from the lethally irradiated chamber.

steps.title: Meet Fawkes outside the Raven Rock exit
steps.description: After fighting your way out of the burning Enclave base at Raven Rock at the end of "The American Dream," you will spot Fawkes mowing down Enclave troops with a salvaged Gatling Laser right along the mountain path.

steps.title: Invite Fawkes into your party with Good Karma
steps.description: Speak with Fawkes once the firefight ends: if you have Positive Karma, he joins your party permanently at no charge. With his massive health pool (up to 15,000 HP in Broken Steel) and rapid-fire Gatling Laser, he can solo Super Mutant Behemoths and Enclave patrols.
steps.tip: If you ever dismiss Fawkes, he will always wait for you outside the entrance to the Museum of History (Underworld).

title: Mothership Zeta: Steerage Rats
summary: An excursion through Mothership Zeta's Maintenance Level and Waste Disposal ("Mothership Zeta: Steerage Rats"): plummet into the garbage chute during a tram ride with Sally, fight through tunnels teeming with alien worms, and track down all 25 Alien Captive Recorded Logs.
startCondition: Starts automatically when you board the cargo tram with Sally on the Maintenance Level or enter Waste Disposal aboard Mothership Zeta.
rewards: "Xenotech Expert" perk (+20% damage with all alien weapons for listening to all 25 Alien Captive Recorded Logs!)
Generous supplies of Alien Crystals, Alien Epoxy (repairs your equipped weapon right from your inventory!), and rare Earth artifacts
missableWarnings: Several Alien Captive Recorded Log terminals are located in the Maintenance Level and Waste Disposal—activate every green console you pass on your way to Sally's control room!

steps.title: Ride the cargo tram down into Waste Disposal
steps.description: Enter the Maintenance Level from the Engineering Core and speak with Sally beside the cargo tram. When the car jumps the rails and crashes into the ship's Waste Disposal hold, Sally crawls into an upper air vent toward the control room to unlock the sealed bulkheads ahead of you.

steps.title: Fight through two levels of waste tunnels to Sally's control room
steps.description: Push through cavernous Waste Disposal chambers cluttered with abducted Earth junk (tractors, road signs, and shipping containers), blasting aggressive Alien Turret Worms, drones, and Abominations while Sally unseals doors along your path.
steps.tip: Loot Alien Epoxy from crates throughout the hold—using it from your Pip-Boy instantly repairs the weapon in your hands without a workbench or spare parts!

steps.title: Listen to all 25 Alien Captive Recorded Logs for the Xenotech Expert perk
steps.description: Rejoin Sally in the Waste Disposal control room and ride the teleporter back to the Engineering Core. Be sure to inspect every green recording terminal across the ship's sectors: listening to all 25 logs from captives across human history grants the permanent "Xenotech Expert" perk (+20% alien weapon damage).

logs: The Lone Wanderer falls into Mothership Zeta's Waste Disposal and Maintenance Level.
Spoke with Sally beside the cargo tram on the Maintenance Level.
Dropped into the lower Waste Disposal chute aboard Mothership Zeta.
Sally crawled through an air vent toward the control console to open the bulkheads.
Entered the main Waste Disposal level infested with alien worms and drones.
Fought through to the control room where Sally is waiting.
Reunited with Sally in the control room—the path to the teleporter is open.
Successfully cleared Mothership Zeta's Waste Disposal sector.

title: Megaton Freeform Quests
summary: A collection of unmarked Freeform Quests around Megaton: repairing leaking pipes for engineer Walter, trading Scrap Metal indefinitely, exposing Leo Stahl's chem stash, and settling affairs among townsfolk like Billy Creel and Maggie.
startCondition: Speak with Walter at the Megaton Water Processing Plant, Leo Stahl at The Brass Lantern, or other townsfolk at any time before potentially detonating the bomb.
rewards: 200 caps for repairing 3 pipes + unlimited Scrap Metal buyouts from Walter (10 caps and 5 XP per piece!)
Key to Leo Stahl's chem stash at the Water Processing Plant and Good Karma
Ongoing discounts from Moira Brown and Doc Church when on good terms with the town
missableWarnings: Walter's pipe repair job unlocks one of the best infinite XP and cap sources in the entire game—be sure to complete it on your very first visit to Megaton!

steps.title: Repair three leaking pipes in Megaton's waterworks
steps.description: Speak with elderly engineer Walter inside the Water Processing Plant on the upper tier of town. Then follow the hissing steam and spraying water to locate 3 leaks: one on the ramp by the gate across from Cromwell's house, one along the lower path behind the clinic and Simms's house, and one on the roof near Moriarty's Saloon entrance. Each pipe requires a Repair skill of at least 30.
steps.tip: The Vault 101 Utility Jumpsuit or a copy of Dean's Electronics makes reaching 30 Repair effortless even at level 2.

steps.title: Sell Scrap Metal to Walter for caps and XP
steps.description: Report the repairs to Walter to earn 200 caps. Afterward, he will buy any Scrap Metal you bring back from the wasteland indefinitely: either for 10 caps and 5 XP apiece, or donated for free to quickly boost Good Karma.

steps.title: Uncover Leo Stahl's late-night chem habit
steps.description: Follow cook Leo Stahl late at night (when he sneaks into the Water Processing Plant) or pick the lock on his stash of Jet and Psycho, then confront him. With a successful Speech check, you can either convince Leo to kick the habit for good (+Karma) or blackmail him for the key to his stash.

steps.title: Help townsfolk and donate to the Church of the Children of Atom
steps.description: Check in with Billy Creel and young Harden Simms, listen to Confessor Cromwell's sermons by the bomb (donating caps to the Church of the Children of Atom lets you raise your Karma anytime), and visit sniper Stockholm up on the outer catwalks.

title: DC Ruins Exploration
summary: Field encounters and skirmishes across the ruined districts of Washington, D.C.: rescuing Brotherhood of Steel Initiate Peabody in Falls Church, clearing a fortified super mutant stronghold, and backing up Lyons' Pride patrols on The Mall.
startCondition: Exit the Metro into the Falls Church ruins (en route to Galaxy News Radio) or explore central Washington, D.C.
rewards: Ammo (5.56mm rounds, Microfusion Cells, and Stimpaks) from rescued Brotherhood of Steel soldiers
Salvaged Power Armor and heavy weapons from fallen combatants in urban firefights
missableWarnings: During the firefights in Falls Church and Galaxy News Radio plaza, prioritize super mutants carrying Missile Launchers and Miniguns quickly to keep Initiate Peabody and the Paladins alive.

steps.title: Cover the Brotherhood squad and Initiate Peabody in Falls Church
steps.description: Emerging from the Metro onto the eastern side of Falls Church drops you straight into a street battle between a Brotherhood of Steel patrol and super mutants. Help the soldiers cover young Initiate Peabody, who is pinned down amid the ruined office buildings.

steps.title: Clear the super mutant machine-gun nest in the corner building
steps.description: Speak with the surviving Brotherhood patrol leader: he asks you to wipe out the super mutants holed up in the neighboring two-story ruin blocking the push toward Chevy Chase. Clear both floors of the building and report back to the squad for ammo and thanks.

steps.title: Support Brotherhood garrisons on The Mall and Vernon Square
steps.description: As you explore central D.C. (the trenches around the Washington Monument, The Capitol, Vernon Square, and Dupont Circle), assist Brotherhood patrols fending off super mutants and centaurs, and collect Brotherhood of Steel Holotags from fallen soldiers to turn in to Scribe Jameson.

title: The Citadel Freeform Quests
summary: Daily operations and freeform assignments inside the Brotherhood of Steel Citadel (the Pentagon ruins): turning in fallen soldiers' Holotags to Scribe Elizabeth Jameson, browsing Knight Captain Dusk's armory, visiting Sawbones in the clinic, and reading archive terminals.
startCondition: Gain access to the Citadel during the main quest "The Waters of Life" (MQ05).
rewards: 100 caps and +5 Good Karma for every Brotherhood of Steel Holotag delivered to Scribe Jameson
Access to Knight Captain Dusk's armory, Sawbones's medical services, and unique Brotherhood archive terminals
missableWarnings: Never drop or sell "Brotherhood of Steel Holotags" looted from fallen Paladins across the wasteland—Scribe Jameson in the A Ring pays 100 caps and awards Good Karma for every single tag!

steps.title: Turn in fallen soldiers' Holotags to Scribe Elizabeth Jameson
steps.description: Locate Scribe Elizabeth Jameson in the Citadel A Ring archives. She maintains the Brotherhood's casualty roll across the Capital Wasteland and pays 100 caps (plus Good Karma) for every Brotherhood of Steel Holotag you recover.
steps.tip: You can collect Holotags from any Knights or Paladins killed fighting super mutants (at Galaxy News Radio, Falls Church, The Mall, and ruined outposts).

steps.title: Gain armory privileges from Knight Captain Dusk
steps.description: Convince Elder Owyn Lyons to grant you quartermaster access, then visit Knight Captain Dusk in the B Ring barracks. She stocks laser and plasma weaponry, Power Armor, and large batches of energy cells, and can repair your gear.

steps.title: Visit Sawbones's clinic and inspect the A Ring terminals
steps.description: In the B Ring, meet the Mister Handy medic nicknamed Sawbones (he heals injuries, cures radiation, and sells Stimpaks), and browse the computer terminals in the Laboratory and A Ring for dossiers on super mutants, the Brotherhood Outcasts, and Project Liberty Prime.

title: Power Armor Training
summary: Power Armor Training at the Brotherhood of Steel Citadel: obtain personal authorization from Elder Owyn Lyons and complete field instruction under Paladin Gunny in the Courtyard.
startCondition: Complete the scientists' evacuation to the Citadel during the main quest "The Waters of Life" (MQ05).
rewards: Permanent "Power Armor Training" perk
Ability to equip all Brotherhood, Outcast, and Enclave Power Armor as well as the unique T-51b set
missableWarnings: If you have already completed the "Operation: Anchorage" add-on, the "Power Armor Training" perk is granted automatically at the end of the simulation—in that case, Paladin Gunny's briefing is unnecessary.

steps.title: Request authorization from Elder Owyn Lyons
steps.description: Inside the Citadel's Laboratory wing (right after completing "The Waters of Life" and starting "Picking up the Trail"), speak with Elder Owyn Lyons and ask for permission to be trained in Brotherhood Power Armor.

steps.title: Find Paladin Gunny in the Citadel Courtyard
steps.description: Step out of the Laboratory into the Citadel's open-air Courtyard, where Lyons' Pride initiates drill, and speak with instructor Paladin Gunny.

steps.title: Complete the briefing and equip Power Armor
steps.description: Listen to Gunny's rundown on balancing servos and hydraulics. After a brief fade to black, your character receives the "Power Armor Training" perk, allowing you to wear any Power Armor suit and helmet in the game.
steps.tip: You can pick up a free set of Brotherhood Power Armor right away in the barracks or loot one from fallen troops outside Galaxy News Radio.

title: This Galaxy Ain't Big Enough...
summary: The Mothership Zeta finale: disable the Death Ray weapons hub, defeat the Alien Captain on The Bridge, and win a starship duel in Earth's orbit!
startCondition: Enter Living Quarters and The Bridge following the Space Walk.
rewards: Mothership Zeta's Bridge as a permanent player base!
Alien Epoxy (repairs ANY weapon in the game!)
Alien Captain's Sidearm
missableWarnings: Avoid firing the main Death Ray at Earth (it's just a brief cutscene/Easter egg); head straight through Living Quarters toward The Bridge instead.

steps.title: Disable the Death Ray and push through Living Quarters
steps.description: In Death Ray Control, destroy all 4 reactors (drop down and take them out before the timer expires), then fight your way through Living Quarters to the elevator up to The Bridge.

steps.title: Capture The Bridge and win the flagship duel
steps.description: Defeat the Alien Captain and his guards on The Bridge. Moments later, a hostile alien mothership appears on radar—work with Elliott and Sally to divert power to the shields and fire the ship's Death Ray until the enemy flagship explodes!

steps.title: Return to the Wasteland
steps.description: Use the teleporter on The Bridge to travel freely between Mothership Zeta and the Capital Wasteland.

objectives.text: Activate the teleporter in the Engineering Core.
Reach the alien ship's Bridge.
Deactivate the Death Ray.
Kill the Alien Captain.
Eliminate the aliens on The Bridge.
Repel the alien ship's attack.
Return to the Capital Wasteland.
(Optional) Activate the alien ship's self-destruct mechanism.
